jobs.title: Project Delivery Manager - Brisbane
jobs.description:
TOMRA Food is a multinational organization and a leading provider of sensor-based sorting, peeling and integrated post-harvest solution for the food industry. Transforming global food production to maximize food safety and minimize food loss by making sure Every Resource Counts™, has been our strength for over 50 years.

At TOMRA, we want people to innovate, show passion in their work and be responsible
. We encourage the freedom to innovate
and take risks that result in breakthroughs that challenge the status quo. We value passion
that focuses and commits to meeting success. We believe in a responsible and safe mindset that takes care of our customers, products, and fellow employees.

Job Description

At TOMRA Food, we're looking for a customer-focused Project Manager to support, coordinate, and lead the successful delivery of complex customer projects across Australia.

This role is ideal for an mid-level career Project Manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building strong customer relationships, and can confidently coordinate people, resources, suppliers, and stakeholders to achieve project outcomes. You'll take ownership of projects from handover through to customer acceptance, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

We are seeking a hands-on project leader who is comfortable working autonomously, navigating ambiguity, and driving results through collaboration rather than technical expertise alone. Experience delivering large-scale projects in industries such as food processing, manufacturing, construction, mining, utilities, infrastructure, or related sectors will be highly regarded.

This role will be remotely based in the Brisbane area, with a preference for candidates located near a major airport to support travel requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Own the contract between TOMRA and customers, ensuring project delivery within time, quality, cost, and customer satisfaction goals
Oversee project processes, ensuring documentation, reporting, and adherence to timelines
Develop project plans, including resource requirements, and lead a project team to deliver contracted outcomes
Manage contract scope, variations, and monitor progress, keeping all stakeholders informed
Communicate project plans, progress, and timing with customers, managing their expectations and responsibilities
Monitor milestones and ensure project tasks are completed and documented throughout the lifecycle
Consult with experts to manage compliance risks and engage third parties as needed
Proactively manage cash flow and financial goals
Document lessons learned and perform root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions
Deliver project handovers and compliance documentation
Conduct project reviews with department leaders and project teams, evaluating risk, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction
Promote a “Safety First” culture throughout the company, our customers, and our industry

Qualifications

A tertiary qualification in Engineering or a related discipline is desirable but not essential
3-5 years of project management experience leading complex, customer-facing projects from initiation through delivery
Experience managing multiple stakeholders across customers, suppliers, contractors, and cross-functional teams
Strong project planning, risk management, budgeting, and project delivery expertise in industries such as manufacturing, food processing, mining, construction, industrial equipment, engineering services, or similar
Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements
Demonstrated ability to work independently, make decisions, and deliver outcomes in remote and dynamic operating environments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence at all levels
Commercial acumen and a customer-focused approach
Proven ability to adapt to changing priorities and timelines, manage ambiguity, and solve complex problems
Ability to work in both an open office setting and on industrial customer worksites
Project Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) are advantageous but not required
Must hold or be eligible to obtain a valid passport, have an unrestricted driver's licence in the country of residence, and be able to travel domestically up to 30%

Additional Information

We welcome candidates from engineering, project coordination, manufacturing, construction, technical customer service, operations, site supervision, and similar backgrounds who are interested in developing a career in project management. You don't need to meet every requirement. If you have experience coordinating projects, working in technical environments, or supporting customer-facing work and are looking to grow your project management career, we'd love to hear from you.

Why work for us

You will have long-term career opportunities, with a globally renowned company and the following:

Competitive salary and company bonus
Professional training and development: We are passionate about people and seeing them succeed
Global career opportunities with a strong record for promoting internally
We love innovation, a collaborative environment where idea sharing and thinking outside the box is encouraged
Be part of a mission to transform how we all obtain, use and reuse the planet’s resources to enable a world without waste
We care for the planet and want to make a difference for the future
Inclusive company culture that values diversity, well-being and strong camaraderie among our teammates
Employee referral bonus

At TOMRA we proudly recognize cultural diversity, inclusiveness of thought and individuals to create a great working environment for our employees. So, even if you don’t think you tick all the boxes and the requirements, but you have what it takes, we would still like to hear from you.

#EveryResourceCounts

#WeAreTOMRA

jobs.description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for a driven and experienced Project Manager to join our team to lead complex marketing and technology projects which have a direct impact on our business performance. You will lead the delivery of critical initiatives, develop the overall detailed delivery plan, oversee the development and implementation of identified initiatives tied to overall company and business unit strategy.

Here are few examples of the kinds of things you’ll do:

Lead critical projects to build foundational value and to bring new growth capabilities
Lead cross-functional teams in the planning and execution of process improvement/transformative projects to deliver intended results and develop close working relationships with cross-functional partners.
Provide subject matter expertise on project and change management efforts.
Develop requirements documentation and all other project related documentation including charters, RACI, implementation plan, communication plan, metric measurement plan, etc.
Determine key project milestones, timelines, resources, deliverables, dependencies, issues, risks, and outcomes.
Ensure project status reports and information roll-up into a Portfolio view accurately.
Ensure solutions conform to user requirements and client's objectives.
Work closely with IT partners and contribute to their agile ceremonies with prioritization of epics and user stories. Along with planning guidance, lead with close monitoring for the planned delivery of every sprint cycle.
Use and improve various methodologies, including project management process, change management concepts, and business process improvement methods.

Who You Are

Strong analytical, strategic, and tactical capabilities including knowledge of PC and project planning oriented software (i.e., Jira)

Experience delivering in an agile/product environment

Time Off Program

Flexible Time Off (FTO) is provided to salaried (exempt) employees and provides the opportunity to take time away from the office with pay for vacation, personal or short-term illness. Employees don’t accrue a bank of time off under FTO and there is no set number of days provided.

Pension Eligible

Work Authorization/Sponsorship

This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For additional information around work authorization needs please use the following links.

Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants

Experience Principal

At Principal, we value connecting on both a personal and professional level. Together, we’re imagining a more purpose-led future for financial services – and that starts with you. Our success depends on the unique experiences, backgrounds, and talents of our employees. And we support our employees the same way we support our customers: with comprehensive, competitive benefit offerings crafted to protect their physical, financial, and social well-being. Check out our careers site to learn more about our purpose, values and benefits.

Principal is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: (Remote) Project Manager
jobs.description:
Systems & Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager

Systems and Software (www.ssivt.com), a division of Harris Computer Systems, is a software development company headquartered in Winooski, VT. S&S's single focus is on delivering horizontally and vertically scalable customer service solutions to the utility industry. Our reputation is one of market-leading software, exceptional solution delivery, and a customer-focused organization.

For a utility, a Customer Information System (CIS) is more than just a collection of records, it's a lifeline between the utility and its most important asset, its customers. From turn-on to move-out, no other system will have the impact on the customer experience that the CIS does, so ensuring that this solution offers the breadth of scope and responsiveness that modern consumers require is a critical priority. Through our flagship product, enQuesta, S&S meets this need for our electric, water, sewer and gas customers by combining an intuitive design with powerful technology. The enQuesta solution not only presents a modern, innovative face for the utility to the end customers, but also enables the utilities to take advantage of the solution's open architecture when developing future programs and initiatives.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 75%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. This opportunity can be performed remotely or from our office in Winooski, VT. Travel, depending on the project(s).

Salary

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Project Coordination & Management

Coordinate components of utility CIS software implementation projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Maintain and update detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets to ensure projects remain on track.
Identify and report issues, risks, or delays in a timely manner to the PMO Manager and stakeholders for resolution.
Provide clear communication and regular updates on project progress to the PMO Manager and project teams.

Process Support & Standardization

Assist the PMO Manager in maintaining project management documentation and processes to ensure consistency across projects.
Adhere to established project management methodologies, including Waterfall and Agile, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with project management practices and help identify areas for administrative efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication

Maintain consistent communication with internal teams, including R&D, Sales, and Delivery, to ensure alignment on project tasks.

Financial Tracking & Reporting

Assist in monitoring project budgets, ensuring expenses are tracked against financial goals.
Track and report on project status, timelines, and financials, generating regular status reports for the PMO Manager.
Collaborate with finance teams to verify financial data aligns with forecasts.

Performance Monitoring

Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as project delivery timelines and budget variance.
Assist in analyzing project execution data to contribute ideas for enhancing team efficiency.
Support the PMO Manager in preparing project status updates and gathering data for issue escalation.
Participate in client-facing discussions, documenting meeting minutes and action items to ensure customer satisfaction.

What We Are Looking For

1-3 years of experience in project management or a related role, preferably within software implementations or technical environments.
Experience in managing project budgets ranging from $10k to over $2.5M.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Spira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Clarizen.
Basic understanding of Waterfall project management; exposure to Agile methodologies is a plus.
Experience tracking project financials or budgets is preferred.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with team members and customers.
Ability to work collaboratively and manage tasks with guidance.
Strong problem-solving abilities with a focus on learning and delivering results.
Experience working in a team-oriented environment, collaborating with cross-functional groups such as Sales, R&D, and Delivery.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on organization and process.
Position may require travel as high as 75% in North America without restriction.
Frequent communication through Teams, phone calls, and email to stay connected with remote teams and leadership.

What We Can Offer

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

About Systems & Software

Systems & Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems & Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

About Harris

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Kenco Logistics, you’re more than just a team member—you’re part of a company that values innovation, integrity, and a strong commitment to its people. As one of the leading 3PL providers in the U.S., Kenco offers a dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. With a focus on safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement, Kenco empowers employees to make a real impact in the supply chain industry while building rewarding careers. Join a company where your contributions help move the world forward—one shipment at a time.

About The Position

This position’s primary responsibility is for the initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and close of a variety of projects (e.g., facility start-ups, facility transitions, system implementations, etc.) awarded to the Project Management Office for implementation. This position is responsible for providing leadership and support for the organization regarding project management initiatives.

Functions

Develop project plans specifying strategy, technical scope, goals, objectives, maintaining budgets, staffing, scheduling, contingency plans and allocation of available resources.
Coordinate project activities with Marketing, Sales, Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, and client staff to ensure goals and requirements are met.
Engage and successfully manage cross-functional teams.
Develop and implement effective communication plans both internal to Kenco and external with customer.
Proactively manage risk and issues and mitigation efforts as appropriate.
Use innovative problem solving and critical thinking approaches to proactively solve a broad range of problems across projects
Identify and/or maintain metrics that drive and measure team and project performance.
Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and/or improve the project management process to reduce cost and improve customer satisfaction.
Ability to manage and reconcile a Detailed Project Budget.
Preparing and presenting end of project reports, e.g. gap analysis, go-forward plans, etc.
Set Milestones and report status to Management and external customers.
Assist with Complex New Business Transition Proposal Responses.
Assisting with New Business Budget Development.
Serve as a Mentor and Trainer role for all new Project Managers.
Other applicable duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in industrial engineering, operations research, or supply chain management required.
4-6 years of experience with product/program/project management or third-party logistics environment required.
Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification required.
Familiarity with WMS, YMS, LMS Tier 1 Systems (e.g. SAP, Red Prairie, Manhattan, etc.) required.
Familiarity with Kenco systems including WES and CWIC strongly desired.
Familiarity with facility layout drawings in a CAD environment required.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred

Competencies

Business Acumen - Knowledgeable in current and possible future policies, practices, trends, technology, and information affecting his/her business and organization.
Communicate for Impact - Proactively communicate with all stakeholders throughout the life cycle of programs and projects.
Influencing Others - Can quickly find common ground and can solve problems for the good of the organization with a minimal amount of noise. Authentically gains trust and support of peers.
Managing Transitions/ Change Management - Effectively plans, manages and communicates changes in processes with appropriate stakeholders.
Strategic Agility - Enable Kenco to remain competitive by adjusting and adapting to innovative ideas necessary to support Kenco’s long-term organizational strategy.

Travel Requirements

Willingness and ability to travel 25-50% of the time, as required.
Will be required to have or the ability to get a valid passport to travel to Canada or Mexico.

Disclosures

Medical insurance including HSA, HRA and FSA accounts
Supplemental insurance including critical illness, hospital indemnity, accidental injury
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Basic Life and Supplemental Life
Short Term and Long Term Disability
Paid Parental Leave

Job Overview

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment — and Relativity is at the center of it.

We are a leading legal data intelligence company. Our extensible, AI cloud platform, RelativityOne, is trusted by the world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies to turn complex data into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, arbitration, and other high-stakes legal matters.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in product environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. We are looking for mid-level professionals across sales, technical solutions, customer success, and marketing to support our continued expansion. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Summary

Job Description and Requirements

This is an exceptional opportunity for an excellent hands-on marketing program manager to help build and drive growth for Relativity in dynamic markets. This is a high-impact, commercially focused role for a marketing lead who is as comfortable advising senior stakeholders as they are rolling up their sleeves to execute against plan.

As the Program Manager, Field Marketing — Asia, based in Singapore, you will own the development of the field marketing strategy and the delivery of marketing plans for the Asia region, with specific focus on Singapore, Hong Kong, India, and South Korea, with accountability for commercial outcomes in the region.

Drawing on deep knowledge of Asia customers, personas, and market dynamics — across four genuinely distinct markets — you will work with the APAC leadership to set the Asia regional marketing agenda, shape and deliver integrated marketing programs, generate regional campaigns and localising global ones to ensure maximum regional relevance, driving pipeline towards meeting aggressive revenue targets.

You will act as a trusted in-region marketing authority to sales leadership and senior stakeholders — translating business objectives into marketing plans, providing strategic counsel, and ensuring marketing is a true commercial driver to success. You will also collaborate closely with Australia, UK and US-based marketing teams, leveraging global capabilities to maximise resources, maintain brand consistency across the Asia region.

As an individual contributor, working in the wider APAC marketing team, you are proactive, driven and work effectively across functions and geographies, holding yourself and others to a high standard. You communicate with authority and clarity, thrive on ownership, and bring credibility and gravitas to influence at every level.

Job Responsibilities

Develop a comprehensive field marketing strategy aligned to regional business priorities and revenue goals, spanning the full customer journey — from awareness through to pipeline acceleration and retention — with a coherent, locally relevant go-to-market narrative at their core.
Plan, manage, and deliver integrated marketing programs including in-person events, executive roundtables, webinars, and third-party activations.
Acts as a senior in-region marketing authority to key stakeholders — advising on marketing strategy and plans, and ensuring alignment between marketing activities and business priorities.
Lead end-of-the-end program management, including timelines, budgets, vendors, and logistics, ensuring delivery on time and within scope.
Serves as the in-region authority for all Asia events — including owning the regional presence at RelFest Sydney and flagship Asia events — leading audience acquisition campaigns, driving registrations and attendance goals, developing supporting content, and building event awareness across the region.
Manages joint marketing relationships with third-party sponsors and channel partners to drive in-market awareness, generate pipeline, and deliver against shared commercial goals.
Amplifies global marketing initiatives to ensure messaging resonates with local audiences, adapting content, channels, and positioning for local relevance. Localises content for Asia audiences and personas.
Collaborates cross-functionally with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Brand, and Marketing Operations to ensure consistent messaging and campaign integration.
Partners with the global content team to execute against the regional content strategy, including the creation of customer success.
Serves as a trusted marketing partner to the in-market sales teams, keeping them informed of programme plans, campaign updates, and access to promotional materials, and building strong relationships that make marketing an integral part of commercial success.
Sets, tracks, and reports on campaign metrics and commercial KPIs; translates performance data into actionable insights and continually optimises programmes to improve outcomes and maximise ROI.
Be accountable for marketing’s contribution to pipeline generation, revenue contribution, and commercial outcomes in market.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in marketing or a related field
7+ years professional experience in marketing, with a track record of owning commercial outcomes in a senior field marketing or demand generation role.
Proven in-market experience across at least one Asia market (Singapore, Hong Kong, India, or South Korea)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in B2B technology or SaaS marketing environments with experience across more than one Asia market: Singapore, Hong Kong, India, or South Korea
Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce)
Breadth of experience across events, field marketing, demand generation and ABM — with the strategic vision to bring these disciplines together into a coherent regional plan

Key Competencies

Execution Excellence: Delivers high-quality work with attention to detail and consistency. Demonstrable programme management skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively, manage competing workstreams, and maintain rigour in a fast-paced environment.
Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships across teams to achieve shared outcomes. Confident working across all levels of a business — from field sales to the CMO — and managing complex, senior stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Communication: Ability to act as an in-region marketing authority — translating business priorities into marketing strategy and providing trusted counsel to senior stakeholders.
Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical mindset. Uses metrics to evaluate success and improve future performance.
Customer Focus: Understands target audiences and contributes to engaging buyer experiences.
Ownership: Takes accountability for campaign and event deliverables from planning through execution and commercial results.

Suggested Skills

Budget Management, Data Analysis, Demand Generation, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Marketing Strategies, Performance Measurement, Program Management, Project Management, Vendor Management

jobs.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

Position Overview

The Healthcare Practice Program Manager owns end-to-end operational performance of Harbor IT's Healthcare POD: the clients, the 9-person delivery team, the projects, and the service delivery workflows that hold it together. This role directly manages a Solution Architect, 3 Sr. Systems Engineers, 3 Technical Support Specialist IIs, 1 Technical Support Specialist, and 1 Project Manager. The POD-CIO and CSM sit inside the POD but report outside it into CX Leadership — the Program Manager is expected to operate in lockstep with both, especially on clinical escalations and EMR-related incidents, but does not manage them.

Organizational Structure

Reports to the Healthcare Practice Director. The POD-CIO owns executive relationships, strategic IT roadmap, and expansion positioning. The CSM owns day-to-day client ops and satisfaction. This role owns POD delivery performance, SLA/KPI attainment, the delivery team, PMO and project outcomes, PSA data integrity, delivery margin inputs, and renewal execution.

Key Responsibilities

Directly manage the Solution Architect, Sr. Systems Engineers, Support Specialists, and Project Manager — hiring, coaching, performance management, and daily workload assignment.
Own SLA/KPI attainment across the POD, with particular attention to EMR uptime, downtime escalation response times, and incident resolution for systems where delays directly affect patient care and clinical workflows.
Serve as the senior escalation point for EMR-related incidents (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks), coordinating with vendor support and clinical stakeholders under time pressure.
Communicate directly and credibly with physicians, practice administrators, office managers, and clinical staff — translating technical issues into language a non-technical clinical audience can act on, and managing expectations during outages or go-lives.
Own queue health, PSA hygiene, and financial inputs (utilization, time entry accuracy, agreement utilization) for the POD.
Lead the POD's PMO function: EMR migrations, system upgrades, new clinic onboarding, and infrastructure projects, from scoping through closeout.
Ensure delivery practices align with HIPAA/HITECH requirements and payer/compliance

obligations relevant to healthcare clients; partner with security/compliance functions on audits and risk findings.

Join client SBRs and project reviews, packaging performance and clinical-impact narratives for practice leadership and executive sponsors.
Own renewal execution for the POD book, working in lockstep with the POD-CIO.

Qualifications & Skills

Hands-on experience supporting EMR/EHR systems in a healthcare IT or MSP environment — administration, migrations, integrations, or escalation support (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, or comparable).
Demonstrated ability to communicate with physicians and clinical stakeholders under pressure — explaining technical root cause and timelines without jargon, and holding composure when a system outage affects patient scheduling or care delivery.
Proven people leadership managing technical/service delivery staff, including hiring and

performance accountability.

Working knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare compliance requirements as they

intersect with IT service delivery.

Hands-on PSA/ITSM platform experience (ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, ServiceNow, or comparable).
ITIL-aligned service management knowledge; comfortable owning SLA targets and reporting against them, including a specific example of recovering from a miss.
Strong executive presence, both client-facing (with doctors and practice administrators) and internal (with the delivery team).
Financial literacy sufficient to own program budgets, utilization, and a renewal/expansion

number.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
6–8 years combining program/project management and service delivery management within an MSP, healthcare IT, or HIT environment, including at least 2 years as a formal manager of technical staff.

Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.

Unlimited PTO and holidays

Candidates based in India only

Matched or contributory pension scheme

Employee assistance programme
My Rewards portal, access to 1000’s of retail discounts
Life assurance
Cycle to work, salary finance and give as you earn schemes
Enhanced maternity, paternity leave and adoption leave
Reward and recognition scheme

In addition, this role offers:

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
2 Paid volunteer days per year

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Location: Germany

Travel:
up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed)

Director, Professional Services, EMEA

Your Impact

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead high-visibility projects, directly contributing to the development and implementation of solutions that truly make a difference. In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust.
At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose.

What You’ll Do

Program & Project Management

Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments
Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management.
Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery.
Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition
Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff.
Operates with a sense of urgency, accuracy, and detail-orientation, while maintaining consistent lines of communication with all teams involved in each project
Maintain customer confidence, especially in high-pressure situations
Remain organized and focused on removing obstacles through creativity and adaptation to rapidly changing circumstances

Partner Management

Own the relationship with 3rd party integrator and the client throughout the length of the contract

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with Professional Services, Product Managers, and Engineers to align program execution with business goals.
Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment.

Process Improvement

Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to increase deployment speed, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices.

What You Bring

Fluency in both German and English
European citizenship is required in order to work with sensitive Government data, willing to undergo a security check
5+ years of experience leading and delivering highly complex programs, with demonstrated success in technical program management.
Proven track record of managing enterprise-level software deployments, infrastructure projects, or large-scale enterprise application programs.
Deep expertise in delivering complex projects involving cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product.
Mastery of program/project management tools and methodologies to track, report, and deliver on objectives. (PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM)
Experience gathering requirements, optimizing workflows, and facilitating change management within teams.
Familiarity with software configurations and coding experience (particularly JSON) preferred.
Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Proficiency in guiding client and internal teams through ambiguity, driving alignment, and executing on shared goals.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

jobs.title: Regional Program Manager - Portland Metro
jobs.description:
POSITION TYPE:
Full-time, exempt; some evening and weekend work required
LOCATION:
Portland metropolitan area; hybrid, with regular work in schools and community settings throughout the region and occasional statewide travel
REPORTS TO:
Director of Education 
START DATE:
Dec 1, 2026
APPLICATION DEADLINE:
Open until filled with priority given to applicants who apply by October 20, 2026. 

CLP is looking for a relationship-builder, community educator, and connector who believes powerful civic learning happens both inside and outside the classroom. The Portland Regional Program Manager will build partnerships among educators, schools, students, community-based organizations, civic institutions, and local leaders throughout the Portland metropolitan area.
This position is designed for someone whose experience crosses traditional boundaries: a community organizer who has worked closely with schools and young people, a nonprofit leader with teaching experience, an educator who has organized communities, or another professional who knows how to bring people together around shared civic-learning goals.
You will not simply deliver programs created elsewhere. You will listen to educators and communities, identify local assets and needs, adapt and deliver CLP programs, and help develop approaches that reflect Portland-area schools and communities. Throughout this work, you will uphold CLP's commitment to nonpartisanship and help create learning environments in which people with different perspectives and backgrounds can participate constructively.

THE ROLE'S THREE CORE PRIORITIES

Build trusted relationships and community partnerships that strengthen civic learning opportunities for students and educators.
Support educators in meeting the goals of Oregon Senate Bill 513 by connecting required civics instruction with meaningful classroom learning and engagement with Portland-area civic institutions and communities.
Develop, implement, and evaluate regional programs and pilots that expand access to high-quality civic learning and inform CLP’s statewide work.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Organizing and Partnership Development

Build trusted partnerships: Develop sustained relationships with schools, culturally and geographically diverse community organizations, youth-serving organizations, civic institutions, local government, legal professionals, and other Portland-area partners.
Community Engagement: Engage educators, students, and community partners to identify local needs, assets, barriers, and opportunities in developing and delivering programming.
Build coalitions: Bring together people and organizations that may not ordinarily work together around the shared goal of strengthening students' civic knowledge, skills, and participation.
Develop community leadership: Recruit, prepare, and support community members to serve as volunteers, speakers, mentors, content experts, and partners in student civic-learning experiences.
Expand access: Identify Portland-area schools, educators, and communities that have had less access to CLP programming and develop relationship-based strategies to increase participation.
Lead regional relationships: Build CLP's presence in education, civic, and community networks and represent CLP at meetings, events, convenings, and professional-learning opportunities.

Educator Partnership and Civic Learning

Support educators: Provide curricular consultation, in-classroom assistance when appropriate, volunteer matching, and follow-through tailored to educators' needs and school contexts.
Connect classrooms and communities: Create opportunities for students to learn with community leaders and explore local legal, civic, and public-policy questions through inquiry and experiential learning.
Facilitate professional learning: Design and lead workshops, teacher cohorts, and other learning opportunities that support implementation of CLP programs, Oregon civics standards, and SB 513.
Adapt CLP programs: Help schools implement programs such as Community Action Projects, Mock Trial, Courthouse Tours, and other CLP offerings in ways that are practical, relevant, and nonpartisan.

Regional Program Development, Delivery, and Learning

Co-design responsive programming: Work with CLP’s Education Team and regional partners to develop student-centered programming that supports implementation of Oregon Senate Bill 513 and is grounded in community knowledge, local resources, and educator needs.
Lead regional pilots: Plan, implement, and refine pilot programs that test community-rooted approaches to strengthening civic learning and collaboration among educators, students, and community partners.
Coordinate events and civic learning experiences: Develop and support tours, conferences, workshops, and other student- and educator-centered programs that connect classroom civics instruction with civic and legal institutions and help educators create meaningful learning experiences aligned with Oregon’s civics requirements.
Manage projects and partnerships: Develop work plans, coordinate logistics, monitor timelines and budgets, and maintain clear communication with internal and external partners supporting regional civic learning.
Use evidence to improve: Collect participant feedback and program data; maintain accurate records in CLP’s CRM; and use findings to strengthen programs, assess how CLP is supporting educators and students under SB 513, and inform statewide learning.
Communicate opportunities: Develop clear, engaging regional communications that connect educators, volunteers, and partners with CLP programs and resources that support high-quality civics instruction.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU...

Are comfortable working across political, geographic, cultural, and institutional differences while maintaining nonpartisanship.
Can operate comfortably in board rooms, classrooms, courtrooms, and community spaces.
Enjoys working with both educators and community members.
Know how to listen to a community before proposing a solution.
Are energized by bringing people and organizations together across different priorities and perspectives.
Can translate broad ideas about democracy and civic participation into practical opportunities for young people.
Enjoy building and improving programs, while also administering established ones.

Minimum Qualifications

At least five years of combined professional experience in community organizing, K-12 education, youth development, nonprofit programming, community engagement, or a closely related field.
Meaningful experience working in both education and community organizing, coalition building, or partnership development.
Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships across communities, institutions, and organizations with different priorities and perspectives.
Experience facilitating groups and communicating effectively with educators, young people, volunteers, community partners, and civic leaders.
Knowledge of interactive, experiential, project-based, or place-based learning strategies.
Ability to manage multiple projects with attention to relationships, timelines, budgets, details, and follow-through.
Familiarity with Portland-area schools, districts, education organizations, community-based organizations, and/or civic institutions.
Ability to navigate complex institutional environments while maintaining CLP's commitment to nonpartisanship.
Strong writing, collaboration, judgment, and organizational skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Residence in the Portland metropolitan area, a valid driver's license and auto insurance, and reliable transportation for regional travel.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working at the intersection of education and community engagement, with familiarity with K–12 schools, educators, students, or youth-serving programs.
Experience with CLP programs or similar student-centered civic-education initiatives.
Established relationships within Portland-area education, youth-development, community, or civic networks.
Experience engaging communities through listening sessions, outreach, volunteer engagement, coalition building, or community-based programming.
Experience in legal, judicial, local-government, or public-policy settings.
Experience with CRM and project-management systems; familiarity with Virtuous, VOMO, Canva, Asana, or Slack is helpful.

Interested but not sure you meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT AND COMPENSATION

Salary range: $65,000-$72,000 annually, based on experience.
Status: Full-time (40 hours per week), exempt employee.
Schedule: Work generally occurs Monday through Friday in a hybrid environment. Hours are flexible to meet the needs of educators and community partners. Some evening and weekend work is required for meetings, programs, and events.
Benefits: Competitive benefits package including full medical, dental, and vision insurance for the employee; long-term disability and life insurance; and a 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer contribution after six months of continuous employment.
Employment requirements: Employment is contingent upon a background check and verification of employment eligibility. Regional travel requires a valid driver's license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation.

Civics Learning Project is an equal opportunity employer. CLP does not discriminate in employment, educational programs, or activities on any basis protected by applicable law.

TO APPLY

Please submit the following materials:
Cover letter: Describe how your experience in education and community organizing or partnership development prepares you for the Portland Regional Program Manager role.
Resume: Clearly describe experience relevant to the position.
References: Provide three professional references, including at least one - preferably two - current or former supervisors.

Email materials as PDFs to employment@civicslearning.org with "Portland RPM" in the subject line. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

The successful candidate will lead programs across the full product development lifecycle, spanning firmware, Linux and Zephyr software stacks, device drivers, Common HAL, ROM and boot software, BSPs, SDKs, middleware, security enablement, low-level I/O, and SoC/MCU platform development.

Job Requirements

As a Principal / Chief Project Manager, you'll be at the heart of these long-term client partnerships. You'll shape delivery strategies, lead complex projects and programmes, bring together our technical capabilities and create the confidence, clarity and commercial discipline needed to deliver safely and successfully. You'll also help identify what our clients need next, strengthen our strategic relationships and support the continued growth of Reactor Operations.

Your role

Depending on your experience and the scale of the role, you'll:

Champion project management best practice and continuous improvement across the wider business.

About You

Significant experience leading complex engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing, energy or major project delivery, ideally within nuclear, defence or another highly regulated sector.
A strong client mindset, with experience building trusted relationships and working collaboratively with senior client, regulatory, stakeholder and delivery teams.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Hi, we’re SambaSafety and we offer the industry’s most comprehensive driver monitoring software. Our mission is promoting safer communities by reducing risk through data insights. Companies trust SambaSafety to keep their employees safe on the roads, price and reduce risk, help protect their brand, their bottom line, and our global community. 

We’ve built an inclusive, supportive, and exceptional culture where every employee is empowered in their role. Don’t take our word for it; we’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace by The Denver Post, Albuquerque Journal, Sacramento Bee, and Built In Colorado. And our employees rate SambaSafety as top-notch, with a rock solid Top Rating on Glassdoor.

What You’ll Do:

Job Summary:

The Technical Program Manager, Engineering owns how work moves through the SambaSafety engineering organization, from a commitment or an idea to something running in production. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role runs the cross-team programs that no single engineering pod owns: platform and data initiatives, infrastructure migrations, reliability and security remediation, and the engineering side of the company’s largest product commitments. The role keeps Jira honest, dependencies visible, risks surfaced early, and stakeholders informed, so engineering leaders decide on facts rather than status meetings.

This is a new role and the first of its kind in Engineering. It is the engineering counterpart to two neighboring functions: Product Management, which owns what gets built and why, and Global Information Systems, which delivers back-office business applications. This role owns how and when engineering work gets delivered. Where Product has a Product Manager on the work, including the data platform and entity resolution capabilities, the Technical Program Manager pairs with them: the Product Manager owns the customer and go-to-market side, and this role owns the cross-team and technical dependencies that those programs generate. Where no Product Manager is assigned, such as infrastructure migrations, security remediation, reliability, and AI tooling rollouts, the role leads the program outright, including stakeholder interviews, scoping, and story creation.

SambaSafety is adopting AI-assisted software delivery through its Concept-to-Cash framework and agentic engineering harness. The Technical Program Manager is a primary operator of that process, making sure stage gates are respected, verification is real, and tooling removes toil rather than adding process.

Role Scope:

Track: 
Individual contributor on the Engineering career path, with room to grow in scope as the program management function matures.

Reports to: 
Chief Technology Officer. No direct reports; success is measured by programs delivered and by the practices other teams adopt.

Working partners: 
Engineering Managers and Directors, Staff Engineers, Product Management, the Senior Project Manager in Global Information Systems, and external engineering partners.

Scope of programs: 
Multi-quarter initiatives touching two or more engineering teams, spanning platform and data work, engineering-only programs, and the engineering side of customer-facing product commitments.

Responsibilities:

Program ownership: 
Run several concurrent cross-pod programs end to end: charter, plan, dependencies, risks, status, and delivery.

Engineering-only programs: 
Lead outright the work no Product Manager is assigned to, such as cloud and infrastructure migrations, AI harness and tooling rollouts, security remediation, and reliability improvements.

Pairing with Product: 
Partner with the assigned Product Manager on customer-facing big rocks and on platform capabilities such as the data platform and entity resolution. Product owns scope, priority, and the customer and go-to-market side; this role owns cross-team technical dependencies, sequencing, and the delivery plan, which is where these programs most often stall today.

Discovery and scoping: 
Conduct stakeholder interviews, define scope and success measures, and record decisions so the reasoning outlives the meeting.

Jira and Confluence: 
Own the epic and story structure for programs, cross-project linking, and the Concept ID conventions that tie Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket together. Write stories engineers can start without a second conversation, and keep program documentation in a form others can pick up and edit.

Planning cadence: 
Run the engineering side of quarterly and annual planning, track big rocks against capacity and commitments, and produce status executives can read in two minutes.

Risk and escalation: 
Surface risks early with options attached, and escalate to the right leader with a recommendation.

Delivery measurement: 
Maintain the metrics that show whether delivery is getting more predictable, including cycle time, commitment accuracy, and adoption of AI-assisted delivery practices.

Partner coordination: 
Coordinate across external engineering partners where programs depend on them, so handoffs are managed rather than discovered.

Process improvement: 
Improve how engineering plans and delivers with the lightest process that works, always explaining the why, and retire process that no longer earns its keep.

What You’ll Need:

5+ years in program, project, or product management within SaaS software organizations, including 2+ years running cross-team technical programs.

A clear track record of getting things shipped: able to point to programs delivered on commitment and the obstacles worked through to get there.

Expert in Jira and Confluence, including building epic and story structures, boards, filters, and dashboards from scratch. Familiarity with Bitbucket and CI/CD pipeline concepts.

Technical fluency: able to read an architecture diagram, understand an API contract or a data pipeline, and ask the right questions of engineers without needing to build it. AWS familiarity is a plus.

Strong stakeholder interviewing and requirements-shaping skills, with the judgment to know when a request is a real need and when it is a symptom.

Plain-spoken written and verbal communication that works for engineers and executives alike.

Comfortable using AI-assisted tools as part of daily work, and curious about how they change program management itself.

Experience with regulated data (FCRA, DPPA, or similar), data-heavy platforms, or a private-equity-backed environment is helpful but not required.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent experience.

Benefits and Perks:

Flexible and generous Paid Time Off and Paid Volunteer Days

401k Employer Match 

Generous Healthcare Benefits 

Up to 12 weeks paid time off for maternity leave based on tenure

Wellness &Tuition Reimbursement

Flexible Work Arrangements

Lots of SambaSafety swag & SambaSafety Events 

Our team of talented and committed safety professionals is exceptional. At SambaSafety we strive to foster an inclusive culture that supports, encourages and celebrates a wide array of diversity. We are committed to create a space where all employees can show up as their authentic selves every day, and we work to advance employee equality, diversity and inclusion.

SambaSafety provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, and expression or genetics.

Come join us to find out for yourself what all the excitement is about!

jobs.title: Director, Technical Program Manager (EPTech)
jobs.description:
Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

Enterprise Platforms Technology ( EPTech
) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We establish practices for building technology solutions across the company and deliver capabilities that exemplify those practices.

As a Director TPM in EPTech, you will leverage your technical acumen and engineering experience to drive the strategy and execution of large-scale, technically complex, cross-functional programs aligned with Capital One’s business priorities. You’ll break down complexity and organizational silos, influence roadmaps, dive deep into system design and architecture, make technical tradeoffs, drive platform consolidation, and identify, resolve, define, and escalate mitigation plans for hard technical dependencies.

What You’ll Do:

As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products & platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.

Contribute to the organization’s TPM / Delivery strategy: establish operating mechanisms, maturity models, and tooling that scale across portfolios
Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
Lead cross-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long-term platform convergence and reuse
Serve as an executive-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field
At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs

Preferred Qualifications:

7+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing or service oriented architecture (SOA)
3+ years of experience in building distributed systems & highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture - preferably using AWS
3+ years experience building highly scalable products & platforms
3+ years of experience with Agile delivery
3+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs - where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact
Experience in building systems & solutions within a highly regulated environment
MBA or Master’s Degree in a related technical field (Computer Science, Software Engineering)
PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
3+ years of people management experience or influencing organization as an IC
Experience driving platform standardization across multiple product portfolios or lines of business
Track record of building TPM maturity (operating models, career frameworks, metrics) at scale within engineering organizations
Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of engaging deeply with technical teams while translating implications into compelling business narratives that persuade senior leadership

Leads cross-functional software development teams delivering ground system capabilities including telemetry, tracking, and command (TT&C), mission planning, automation, and data processing
Manages project lifecycle from concept through operations, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, security and mission objectives are met

Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional software teams through iterative or incremental development and delivery

Demonstrated experience serving as an Agile delivery lead, iteration manager, Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, Product Owner partner, or equivalent role
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

PMP, PMI-ACP, Professional Scrum Master (PSM), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or comparable Agile or program-management certification
Technical domain knowledge of scalable architecture, distributed infrastructure in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
At least 2 years of experience in satellite, aerospace, defense, intelligence, or other space-system domains

Experience operating in environments that combine Agile software development with formal systems engineering, milestone reviews, configuration management, cybersecurity, or government acquisition requirements

Salary commensurate based on education and relevant experience

Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. .
Newmark is seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives across Newmark's global environment. Reporting to the Global Head of IT Support & Operations, this position will have primary responsibility for managing infrastructure projects associated with Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), IT integrations, office relocations and facilities projects, technology migrations, audit and governance initiatives, and enterprise infrastructure programs.
The role requires a strong project manager who can coordinate multiple technical and business workstreams, manage dependencies and risks, work effectively with senior stakeholders and vendors, and drive projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handoff.

Responsibilities:

Mergers & Acquisitions and IT Integrations

Manage IT workstreams associated with acquisitions, mergers, divestitures, and business integrations.
Develop and manage comprehensive IT integration plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and cutover activities.
Coordinate infrastructure discovery and technology assessments for acquired organizations.

Coordinate with acquired-company IT teams, external vendors, and Newmark stakeholders throughout the integration lifecycle.

Facilities, Office Relocations & Real Estate Projects

Manage IT delivery for new offices, office relocations, expansions, consolidations, renovations, and closures.
Partner closely with Facilities, Corporate Real Estate, business leadership, infrastructure teams, and external vendors.
Develop technology requirements, budgets, schedules, equipment plans, and implementation timelines aligned with construction and move schedules.
Coordinate circuits, structured cabling, network switches, Wi-Fi, workstation technology, conference rooms, printers, telephony, AV, and other office technology requirements.
Track equipment procurement, vendor delivery, installation, testing, and site readiness.
Coordinate technology cutovers and ensure offices are operational and ready for employees on scheduled move-in dates.

Technology Migrations

Lead enterprise infrastructure and technology migration projects.
Develop migration strategies, schedules, user groups, communication plans, testing requirements, cutover plans, rollback plans, and post-migration support.
Coordinate Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint, file/data, identity, endpoint, network, cloud, and collaboration-platform migrations.
Manage migration dependencies across internal engineering teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
Track migration progress, exceptions, remediation activities, and overall completion.
Ensure appropriate validation and operational handoff following migrations.

Infrastructure Project Management

Lead projects from initiation and requirements gathering through planning, execution, implementation, stabilization, and closure.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, decision logs, and project documentation.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and workstreams across different business units and geographic regions.
Establish clear project ownership, deliverables, deadlines, and accountability across technical teams.
Facilitate project kickoffs, working sessions, status meetings, steering meetings, and post-implementation reviews.
Identify risks and issues early and drive resolution or escalation to appropriate leadership.
Ensure completed projects transition successfully into operational support.

Audit, Risk & Governance

Manage and coordinate technology initiatives associated with internal and external audits, IT controls, risk remediation, compliance, and governance requirements.
Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Infrastructure, and other technology teams.
Track audit findings, remediation plans, control gaps, owners, target dates, supporting evidence, and closure.
Coordinate collection and validation of documentation and evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
Maintain clear reporting of open findings, risks, dependencies, and remediation status.
Ensure infrastructure projects follow Newmark's technology standards, security requirements, change management processes, and governance frameworks.
Support continuous improvement of project governance, documentation, reporting, and operational controls.

Vendor, Procurement & Financial Management

Coordinate third-party technology vendors, managed service providers, telecommunications providers, consultants, and implementation partners.
Assist with Statements of Work (SOWs), proposals, project estimates, equipment requirements, licensing, and vendor deliverables.
Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and technology leadership as required.
Track project budgets, forecasts, purchase requirements, equipment orders, invoices, and financial commitments.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Escalate vendor risks or delivery issues that could impact project timelines or business operations.

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management

Provide clear and concise project reporting to the Global Head of IT Support & Operations
, IT leadership, business leadership, and other stakeholders.
Develop project dashboards covering overall status, milestones, accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and financial status.
Translate technical issues into understandable business impact for non-technical stakeholders.
Coordinate stakeholders across multiple teams, business units, geographic regions, and vendors.
Escalate critical risks and decisions with clearly documented impacts, options, owners, and required actions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of IT project management experience
, preferably within a large, geographically distributed enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience managing complex M&A integrations, infrastructure migrations, office relocations/facilities projects, and enterprise technology initiatives
.
Experience coordinating multiple technical workstreams including Network, Endpoint, Identity, Microsoft 365, Security, Applications, Service Desk, and Infrastructure.
Experience managing audit, governance, risk remediation, or compliance-related technology initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies and dependencies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Strong experience managing project schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets, vendors, and executive reporting.
Experience working with technical engineering teams as well as senior business stakeholders.
Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or similar project management certification.
Experience managing technology workstreams associated with corporate acquisitions and integrations.
Experience managing IT requirements for large office relocations, expansions, renovations, and new-office openings.
Experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Active Directory, Intune, Azure, networking, Wi-Fi, endpoint technologies, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar project and portfolio management platforms.
Experience supporting internal/external IT audits and technology governance programs.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Business Operations Manager is a generalist, cross-functional leader who bridges the business, data, and engineering/AI teams and is responsible for enabling high-quality, data-driven decision-making, operational alignment, and communication across the organization. This role establishes and facilitates the business processes, operating rhythms, and governance that enable Engineering, Programs, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and other functional teams to make informed decisions, manage risk, and execute against company priorities, with a specific focus on driving efficient data flows and partnering with software/AI teams to operationalize our most critical, data-driven business decisions such as budgeting and capital investment (capex).

This role owns making the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process more efficient and effective, facilitating aspects of it as a central cross-functional forum to align demand, supply, capacity, inventory, and financial objectives, including the inputs that feed downstream decisions like budgeting and capital planning. Beyond SIOP, this person will help identify which other operational processes the business strategically needs and then design, stand up, and lead them, bringing the same cross-functional rigor and data discipline applied to SIOP.

Success in this role requires navigating ambiguity, translating complex data into actionable insights, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities, and continually improving the systems, analytics, AI/automation tooling, and governance that support operational excellence in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Role

Own aspects of and continually improve the company's monthly SIOP process, ensuring timely inputs, scenario analysis, and clear decisions at each step, while concurrently owning other strategic, cross-functional processes that affect operational decision-making and require the same rigor.
Facilitate structured business reviews, SIOP and beyond, that align Sales, Programs, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and other functional teams around priorities, risks, dependencies, and execution plans.
Translate ambiguous business questions (e.g., "should we approve this capex request?") into the data, reporting structure, and process needed to answer them repeatably, not just producing a one-off analysis.
Develop and maintain trusted reporting dashboards, KPIs, and data governance processes that provide leadership with accurate, actionable insights.
Partner closely with data science, digital, and AI/automation teams to improve planning systems, reporting capabilities, automation, and analytics that support scalable business operations, including hands-on evaluation and direction of new AI-enabled tools as they become available, not just coordinating with the teams that build them.
Identify cross-functional risks, constraints, and opportunities, driving mitigation plans and ensuring decisions are documented, communicated, and executed.
Partner with Finance and functional leaders to ensure operational plans support strategic and financial objectives.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing processes, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities, partnering with functional leaders to design improved ways of working, and driving measurable improvements to operational performance.
Lead implementation of process improvements through excellent project management, stakeholder coordination and buy-in, defining business requirements, supporting software system development, driving change management, and ensuring successful adoption of new processes and tools.

Basic Qualifications

Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Engineering, Business, Finance, or related field.
5 – 8+ years of progressive experience in business operations, S&OP/SIOP, program management, supply chain, production planning, engineering operations, or other cross-functional operational leadership roles within advanced manufacturing, electronics, aerospace, medical devices, or related technology-intensive sectors.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with a proven ability to influence and drive decisions cross-functionally and at all levels of an organization (executive leadership to execution teams).
Experience leading impactful cross-functional projects involving data and business processes.
Hands-on data query and analysis ability (e.g., SQL, Python, or R).
Able to translate an ambiguous business question into the data and reporting structure needed to answer it repeatably.
Comfortable partnering with software engineering and AI/ML teams - can scope requirements, evaluate tooling, and speak credibly about feasibility and tradeoffs without being a hands-on engineer.
Has worked in a scaling or fast-changing environment where processes had to be built from the ground up, not just inherited and maintained; comfortable with ambiguity and a lack of existing playbooks.
Track record designing and standing up new operational processes from scratch, not just optimizing existing ones.
Experience supporting recurring, high-stakes business decision cycles such as budgeting, forecasting, or capital investment (capex) approval workflows.
Preferred: platform proficiency in ERP/MRP and advanced planning or analytics tools (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, o9, Power BI, or similar).
Preferred: solid understanding of key supply chain concepts: forecasting, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time management, and product lifecycle management.
Preferred: experience operating in a hardware technology environment, where physical production constraints (supply chain, capacity, lead times) intersect with software/data-driven decision-making.

Behavioral Competencies

Generalist mindset: equally comfortable in a finance/budgeting conversation, a process-mapping workshop, or a requirements discussion with engineers.
Growth mindset with a track record of building or maturing processes, not just operating in steady-state environments.
Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous environments with imperfect data and time-constrained decisions.
Systems thinker who sees end-to-end value streams and can simplify complex data and business planning processes into high level visuals and discussions for decision-making.
Data-driven and highly analytical, comfortable challenging assumptions and using facts to resolve conflicts.
Strong collaborator who breaks down functional silos and creates shared ownership of the plan.
Bias for action, with a focus on execution, follow-through, and measurable results.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating with urgency and ambiguity while still driving structure and accountability.
Strong influencer and facilitator who can navigate conflicting priorities, challenge assumptions, and align senior leaders and technical teams around difficult tradeoff decisions.

What Success Looks Like

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role. Success is measured by how much faster and more reliably the business can move from a data-driven question - budgeting, capex, or otherwise - to an operational decision, and by the quality and durability of the processes and data flows put in place to make that repeatable

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in our Torrance, CA office.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels S06 - S07 as evaluated through our interview process.

SIOP Manager (Lead) / S06: $133,580 - $183,680
SIOP Manager (Principal) / S07: $154,300 - $212,160

Pay Range: $133,580 USD - $212,160 USD

What We Offer:

Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.
