jobs.title: Risk Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Job Title:
Risk Intelligence Manager

Department: Risk Intelligence

The Risk Intelligence organization at Signifyd is responsible for proactively detecting and continuously monitoring fraud activities to mitigate immediate financial losses and protect portfolio health. This team partners closely with Data Science to improve machine learning (ML) model performance by providing continuous feedback on model outputs and identifying areas for enhancement using real-world fraud patterns and merchant feedback. We enhance detection mechanisms to reduce friction for merchants and their customers while driving revenue. We build trust through responsiveness and expertise, fostering stronger merchant relationships. We demonstrate the value of fraud prevention solutions in driving revenue growth and reducing losses.

About the role:

In this role, you will lead and develop a team of fraud analysts who investigate emerging threats, respond to fraud incidents, and translate behavioral insights into effective risk strategies. You will strengthen the people, tools, processes, and analytical standards that enable the team to succeed. This includes coaching analysts, improving investigative practices, establishing best practices, and helping team members develop the skills needed to solve increasingly complex risk problems.

You will partner closely with Risk leadership and teams across Data Science, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Together, you will turn investigative findings into scalable improvements that reduce fraud losses, support intelligent risk-taking, and improve customer experiences. Success in this role requires strong people leadership, analytical judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to communicate complex risk issues clearly to technical, business, and customer audiences.

At Signifyd, you will be part of a purpose-driven company dedicated to creating a dynamic and versatile work environment. Risk Intelligence is an integral part of our growing organization that values neighborly collaboration, passion, and inventiveness.

Responsibilities:

Hire, coach, and performance-manage a team of fraud analysts, closing skill gaps and serving as the escalation resource for complex investigations and emerging attacks.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Position Summary

The Market Intelligence Analyst serves as the central intelligence capability covering four key pillars: macro and trade lane, carrier, competitor, and customer/segment intelligence. Covering ocean, air, and rail freight across major global lanes, this role translates complex market data into actionable commercial insights. Crucially, the analyst is responsible for providing credible, data-backed intelligence that directly influences both short-term pricing actions and long-term pricing strategy. A primary measure of success in this role is the ability to spot commercial signals from external sources ahead of time and coherently alert leadership to impending market shifts before they fully materialize.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Signaling & Pricing Influence

Provide credible, quantitative market intelligence to directly influence short-term pricing decisions and shape the long-term pricing outlook.
Proactively monitor external sources and macroeconomic indicators to spot early commercial signals and leading indicators of structural market shifts.
Coherently present forward-looking pricing outlooks, flagging external market changes ahead of time to allow commercial teams to adjust strategy proactively.
Evolve the macro data dashboard into a predictive internal demand signal that the Trade team directly prices against, rather than acting as a retrospective report.

Recurring Deliverables & Market Reporting

Author and publish fixed-cadence outputs, including a Monthly Export Newsletter for external shippers and internal Sales, and a Weekly Intel Digest.
Produce the comprehensive Quarterly Market Update (Internal & External Webinar versions), encompassing economic outlooks and sea freight analysis.
Maintain and refresh the internal MI Data Dashboard monthly, aggregating macro indicators (GDP, PMI, inflation, retail sales) across 9 core geographies.
Execute weekly manual updates of rate and index pulls to maintain continuous historical data series.

Strategic Analysis & Geopolitical Scenarios

Maintain live forward-looking frameworks, including trigger forward calendars and comprehensive trigger playbooks.
Conduct deep-dive market-entry and lane assessments evaluating dimensions like consolidation, agency restarts, and FTA campaigns.

Cross-Functional Enablement & Crisis Management

Provide continuous operational and enablement support for Marketing, Sales, Operations, Legal, and Finance.
Manage ad-hoc crisis communications, such as the Middle East crisis page updates, bilingual notice templates, and customer FAQs regarding major disruptions.

Required Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Supply Chain or a related analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years in market intelligence, market research, or business or commercial analysis, ideally in a B2B environment.
Strong B2B commercial sense: you understand supplier and customer dynamics and can see how market events affect rates, volumes and customer relationships.
Experience gathering and checking information from many sources (websites, industry reports, news, financial results) and turning it into clear, accurate insight.
Confident everyday use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to work faster, with the discipline to fact-check and add your own judgement.
Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort with numbers, trends and indices.
Clear, concise communication in English, with the ability to explain complex developments simply to internal teams and customers.
A curious, proactive mindset. You notice the small signals others miss and explain what they mean for the business.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience in freight forwarding, container shipping or wider logistics.
Familiarity with freight market data sources (e.g. SCFI, Drewry WCI, Freightos FBX, Xeneta, Sea-Intelligence).
A background in academic or market research, or in another complex B2B industry.
Experience writing customer-facing communications or market updates.
SQL, Python or dashboarding skills are a plus.

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit!

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

Who We Are

Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.

Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.

To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.

This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.

A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.

What You’ll Be Doing

This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…
Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency

About You

You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.

Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.

Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs
that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement

You actively support and mentor junior team members,
helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity

Let’s Talk Pay

We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD
, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.

At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:

100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!

Our Human Approach to Hiring

At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.

Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.

At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Description

Pueo is known for bringing the best talent and unique tools to every opportunity. Pueo's Parliament (aka workforce) is composed of professionals who are seeking the opportunity to work in a business organization that thrives on career development and independence. In support of mission and professional growth, our Parliament has supported the development of multiple patents, proprietary tools, and applications as well as trademarked processes.

Our organization emphasizes career development across multiple career environments (at the members own pace) and ensures those who contribute broadly are properly rewarded. Pueo has four career environments where every member of the parliament can participate. Each environment has opportunities available for all levels. Opportunities are framed by an employee's desires and capabilities, and we ensure challenges, growth, and unique experiences are available for employees at all levels.

Our Career Environments (Program, Functional, Service, and Leadership) provide numerous opportunities for employees to invest in their personal growth and those things that offer fulfillment. We invest in helping our members create and execute their career development plans. Our Pods (small teams of 5 or less) are comprised of personnel with similar skillsets to ensure mentorship, understanding, and peer support.

Overview

The Zero Trust Data Analyst supports the CIO Zero Trust program by collecting, validating, analyzing, and reporting data that informs program decisions, maturity assessments, performance tracking, risk identification, and implementation planning. This mid-level role works with program, technical, architecture, finance, and mission stakeholders to turn fragmented program data, technical inputs, metrics, and reporting requirements into accurate, decision-ready products.

The Data Analyst develops and maintains dashboards, trackers, data models, briefings, and recurring reports that provide visibility into Zero Trust initiatives, capability progress, dependencies, gaps, funding, risks, and outcomes. The role supports data calls, governance reviews, leadership updates, and audit or compliance responses, while ensuring data is traceable, appropriately sourced, consistently defined, and protected in accordance with security requirements.

General Duties

Collect, clean, validate, reconcile, and maintain program data from authoritative sources, including project trackers, architecture artifacts, requirements, risk registers, data calls, meeting records, implementation plans, and stakeholder inputs.
Develop repeatable data collection methods, templates, data dictionaries, naming conventions, metric definitions, quality checks, and reporting procedures for Zero Trust program data.
Analyze Zero Trust implementation data to identify trends, gaps, dependencies, blockers, risks, ownership issues, schedule impacts, and opportunities for improved execution.
Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, charts, briefing visuals, status reports, and executive-ready summaries that communicate program performance, maturity, and risk posture.
Support Zero Trust maturity assessments, capability mapping, pillar reporting, milestone tracking, and leadership decision support using quantitative and qualitative data.
Coordinate with technical teams, pillar advisors, architects, program managers, governance staff, cybersecurity personnel, and mission stakeholders to gather, clarify, and validate data inputs.
Maintain traceability between reported metrics, source data, assumptions, calculations, responsible owners, reporting periods, and supporting documentation.
Respond to data calls and support recurring reporting requirements by preparing accurate, timely, and well-documented responses for program leadership and Government stakeholders.
Perform quality reviews to identify inconsistent, incomplete, outdated, duplicate, or conflicting data and coordinate with data owners to resolve discrepancies.
Recommend improvements to data management, reporting workflows, automation, dashboards, and analytic products to reduce manual effort and improve leadership visibility.

Required Qualifications

Working knowledge of data analysis methods, data quality management, metric development, dashboarding, reporting, and data visualization practices.
Knowledge of program metrics, maturity tracking, risk reporting, and federal or DoD program reporting environments.
Familiarity with data sources and artifacts such as project trackers, risk registers, requirements, architecture inventories, implementation schedules, data calls, and governance records.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, data validation, and data reconciliation skills.
Proficiency with Tableau, Python, SQL, as well as Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint, and common collaboration or task-tracking tools.
Ability to develop data dictionaries, metric definitions, dashboards, trackers, scorecards, charts, and executive-ready analytic products.
Strong technical writing and briefing skills, including the ability to summarize complex data, assumptions, trends, gaps, and risks for technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to turn incomplete, inconsistent, or fragmented information into reliable analytic outputs and decision-support products.
Ability to manage multiple reporting cycles, data calls, dashboards, and stakeholder requests under tight deadlines.
Ability to work across technical, program, cybersecurity, architecture, acquisition, finance, and mission teams while protecting sensitive information.
Ability to identify data issues, clarify assumptions, document limitations, and elevate risks or inconsistencies appropriately.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 12 years of work experience required. Work experience must include a minimum of 4 years performing data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, metrics tracking, business intelligence, or program analysis.
Demonstrated experience collecting, cleaning, validating, reconciling, analyzing, and presenting data from multiple sources in support of leadership reporting or operational decision-making.
Experience developing dashboards, trackers, charts, scorecards, briefing visuals, data dictionaries, metric definitions, or recurring status reports using Tableau, Excel, SharePoint, or similar tools.
Experience supporting federal, DoD, IC, cybersecurity, enterprise IT, Zero Trust, or large-scale modernization programs preferred.

Certifications

Preferred but not required: Tableau Desktop Specialist, Tableau Certified Data Analyst, Tableau Certified Consultant, Microsoft Excel Expert, Certified Analytics Professional, data analytics, or visualization-related credentials.

Clearance

Active Top Secret clearance minimum required

Pueo is an equal employment opportunity employer and affirmative action employer. All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or protected veteran status. Pueo takes affirmative action in support of its policy to advance diversity and inclusion of individuals who are minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Connaissance en matière de gestion de projet relatif à la donnée

Esprit d’analyse et capacité de synthèse, qualités rédactionnelles
Pragmatisme et approche « utilisateur »

jobs.description:
Who We Are
(video)

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. Our expertise in engineering innovation and semiconductor technologies allows us to deliver mission-critical microelectronics solutions, aerospace systems engineering, and cutting-edge research and development. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

🚀 Join JRC's Missles & Space Team!

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Program Analyst to support the Navy Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) Nuclear Weapons Surety (NWS) Policy and Compliance Branch (SP31), Nuclear Sea Launched Cruise Missile (SLCM-N) . This role requires subject matter expertise in Nuclear Weapons Technical Inspections, safety and security programs, incident response, and operational assessments. Responsibilities include providing technical and administrative support for SLCM-N mission support, developing and maintaining NWS training materials, , evaluating NWS policies and program effectiveness, and recommending improvements. The analyst will also assess hazards at weapon-related facilities and support community management for the NW Limited Duty Officer and Chief Warrant Officer communities, including task analysis, metrics, and training. Expertise in radiological emergency response and interagency coordination is essential.

💼 What You'll Do

Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support and assist the Government with technical analyses, inquiries, research, testing, and data validation for any matter relating to the SLCM-N weapons systems aboard submarines and support facilities.
Support the customer by interfacing directly with SSP staff on all matters related to NWS.
Assist the customer in identifying, planning, developing, and delivering NWS products, procedures and processes that support SLCM-N .
Propose and execute revisions to ordnance documents (OD), Strategic Systems Programs Instructions (SSPINST), and other documentation as required in support of SSP.
Provide administration and inspector support for nuclear weapons inspections, including pre- and post-support documentation (checklists, archiving results, report generation, trend analysis, deficiency action resolution) and on-site support.
Support sustainment, maintenance, connectivity, training and qualification, and operation of the SSP Emergency Communication Center and related personnel to include Command Duty Officers, Emergency Response Organization, Outreach Events, and After-Action Reports. Support improvements to Information Technology infrastructure. This shall include on-site support by one person from the JRC team during normal working hours.
Provide support for sustainment, maintenance, connectivity, training and qualification programs in support of the SLCM-N weapons system to include interactions with the Type Commanders, Groups, Squadrons and SSNs on all matters related to successful employment system and programs required to meet all higher directives, policies and program requirements.
Regularly participate in meetings requiring close interactions with various project stakeholders (clients, SMEs, and end users).
Support SSP in the preparation of fully coordinated program plans and required documentation to include requirements, master plans, cost estimates, testing plans, and other required documentation. Provide detailed analysis and documentation for critical planning recommendations.
Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and program briefs, status reports, memorandums, and formal letters.
Track work and schedules to ensure work is completed within scheduled parameters.
Produce quality results in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

🧠 What You Bring to the Table

10 years of experience in the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) / Strategic Weapons Systems (SWS) and Nuclear Weapons Surety (NWS) programs or equivalent SSN TLAM strike operations .
An active DoD security clearance at the Top-Secret level or above (or have held and active TS clearance within the last 2 years)
Active-duty experience (former Missile Technician, Fire Control Technician, Torpedoman’s Mate , Submarine Weapons Limited Duty Officer (6260), or Weapons Officer(1120)) in submarine service.
Familiarization of DoD Nuclear Weapons Accident Response Procedures (NARP) and National Incident Management Systems (NIMS) is a plus.
Understanding of procedural disciplines required to operate within ordnance documents (OD), special weapons ordnance publications (SWOPs), firing craft procedures (OD44979) , Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and other related special weapons documentation.

⭐ Bonus Points

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited university related degree preferred
Virginia Class VPT/Strike operational experience
SSN operational Nuclear Weapons experience
Submarine C3 experience required to perform Authentication of Sealed Authenticator System (SAS)
Served/Qualified as a Nuclear Weapons Inspector on USFF/PACFLT or Nuclear Weapons worker

An exceptional employee benefits program, providing support for our team members' well-being and success
The chance to contribute to a high-profile Department of Defense programs and make a positive impact
A collaborative work environment where teamwork, creativity, and innovation thrive
Opportunities for professional growth and development, helping you advance your career

The primary responsibility of the Senior Quantitative Research Analyst is to oversee all aspects of the quantitative tools and methods used to monitor, score, and source investment managers. This includes maintaining and improving existing tools, as well as creating and designing innovative tools that improve the efficiency, consistency and effectiveness of the research and due diligence process.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores, Growth & Development team is seeking a Sr. Construction Program Manager, a leader who combines deep construction industry expertise with the strategic vision and operational rigor needed to build scalable programs from the ground up. This is a program-focused role, not a Construction Project Manager position. You'll design governance frameworks, formalize what doesn't exist, fix what's broken at a systemic level, and equip hundreds of team members to do their jobs more effectively through disciplined Procore adoption, structured training, and scalable SOPs.

As our portfolio scales, information must flow end-to-end with minimal manual intervention, and every team member from Design to Construction Project Managers to Store Operations must be appropriately equipped to operate within governed, consistent processes. You will own that outcome - not by managing individual projects, but by designing, governing, and continuously improving the systems, standards, and tools that construction teams operate within so that our team can successfully execute individual project outcomes.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities

This role spans construction program strategy, platform governance, and organizational enablement across a portfolio of more than 600 active pipeline projects and growing. Core responsibilities include:

Develop and govern company policy, construction standards, and the Whole Foods Market (WFM) standard construction specification book.
Own end-to-end Procore process governance for execution teams (RFI, Submittals, Bidding Tool, and PCO/CCO workflows) and ensure information flows seamlessly across the construction lifecycle.
Advocate for system enhancements, integrations, and functionality improvements that drive scalability as the portfolio grows.
Govern value engineering review processes and cost governance frameworks across the construction portfolio.
Partner with Strategic Category Management and Vendor Management on GC performance assessment and scorecard frameworks.
Develop and govern permitting and entitlements coordination frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
Define milestone frameworks and scheduling standards that Construction Operations Groups operate within.
Build and deliver role-based training curricula, SOP libraries, and change management programs for Procore and Coupa adoption.
Identify AI and automation opportunities within construction workflows and develop roadmaps in partnership with the LSA Product Management team.

A day in the life

No two days look exactly the same. You start your morning reviewing Procore compliance dashboards, flagging a pattern in stalled submittals (a process gap, not a project problem) for leadership. Mid-morning, you're presenting a business case for a Bidding Tool integration to a Procore Steering Committee. After lunch, you're facilitating cross-functional alignment across Pipeline, Indirect Procurement, and Construction teams. Late afternoon, you're delivering a Procore onboarding session using a curriculum you built. By end of week, you've advanced two SOPs, submitted enhancement requests, and documented a training gap to close next quarter.

About The Team

Amazon's Worldwide Retail Grocery Development (WWRGD) team manages the full lifecycle of Amazon and Whole Foods Market grocery retail and industrial facilities — from pre-lease due diligence through construction delivery, facilities maintenance, and decommissioning. With more than 600 active sites, 100+ active pipeline locations, and a portfolio scaling toward 2,000+ active projects, we operate at the intersection of construction, technology, and organizational scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class facilities faster, at best value, and with greater consistency across every site we build and maintain.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
7+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience
Experience in construction, or experience developing MOPs and SWMS for planned works
Demonstrated Procore expertise across RFI, Submittals, Bidding, Change Management, and PCO/CCO financial workflow modules
Experience developing and governing permitting, entitlements, and regulatory compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting with ability to translate construction program data into executive-facing insights (PowerBI or equivalent)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing and implementing training programs
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project, program or product management with focus on technical education programs
Experience using managed ML/AI solutions
Experience in grocery retail, food service, or temperature-controlled facility construction environments

jobs.title: Regional Security Manager
jobs.description:
About The Job

Job summary

Explore the world of HMRC Estates, where we lead the way in government property transformation. As a key player in one of the UK's largest property programmes, HMRC Estates offers safe, inclusive workplaces and exceptional career development opportunities. Our team is dedicated to delivering high-quality, user-friendly services that enable our colleagues to thrive in an environment where they truly belong. Watch the video below to meet some of our team and come and discover a career in your hands at HMRC.

Build a Career in Property with HMRC Estates

Estates is at the forefront of delivering the biggest property programme in the UK. We are the leading edge of Government property transformation. The purpose of Estates is to provide HMRC with an estate which is the right size and shape to meet both the current and future needs of our customers in HMRCs business areas. We are a customer service organisation which exists to offer high quality, easy to use services to enable our colleagues to perform at their best by providing working environments in which they want to work.

Job Description

In this role, you will be responsible for assuring the efficient and effective management of all aspects of operational security for sites within your area of responsibility.

You will contribute to managing the contract by being responsible for monitoring and reporting Key Performance Indicators associated with HRMC's external security service providers .

You will ensure that day-to-day responsibilities for building related operational security obligations are met in accordance with the National Security Policies, including those policies that are owned by other directorates and government departments.

You will operate in line with HMRC's strategy, Government standards and industry best practice to promote and enhance site security and preparedness to keep HMRC's people, assets, and buildings safe and secure.

Person specification

Key Responsibilities

Identify, record, and analyse all building related security risks.
Undertake Level One Security Assurance in line with documented processes.
Work with the stakeholders to support and progress Security initiatives and project work.
Produce and maintain building security management documentation.
Undertake regular security reviews to ensure controls are adequate and meet existing standards and emerging threats and risks.
Work closely with the supplier with day to day activities and performance assurance.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of physical security posture.
Support and collaborate with the incident manager with operational security incidents in line with HMRC and cross government guidelines.
Actively engage in any security exercises and initiatives Communicate security status, updates, risk and issues.
Proactively seek out and develop and expand contacts and networks and share best practice from lessons learnt and networking in order to drive continuous improvement.
Be visible and provide Security SME (Subject Matter Expert) advice.
Management security systems access and disclosure of information in line with guidance.
On-call requirement for out of hours cover.

Essential Criteria

Experience and knowledge of an operational security environment.
Experience of contract management skills.
Experience of customer relationship management including dealing with a diverse range of stakeholders.
Proven track record of analysing and resolving problems, developing opportunities, and implementing innovate solutions/approaches.
Able to demonstrate personal self-development.
Knowledge of operational security risk management.

Further Information

If one of the following is not already held, there is an expectation to complete the following:

BTEC level 5 in Security Management within 2 years.
Contract Management Foundation Level within 6 months.
Threat and Risk Analysis Training Pathway incorporating BTEC Level 4 in Security Coordination and Design within 2 years.
Membership of the security institute.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

Making Effective Decisions
Working Together
Managing a Quality Service
Delivering at Pace

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £37,682, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £10,916 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.

Pension - We make contributions to our colleagues' Alpha pension equal to at least 28.97% of their salary.
Family friendly policies.
Personal support.
Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what it's really like to work for HMRC hear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths and Experience.

How To Apply

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

A name-blind CV, to include your Job History, Full Qualification Details and Previous Skills/Experience.
A 750-word Personal Statement, describing how your Skills and Experience would make you suitable for the role, and how you meet the Essential Criteria and Person Specification.

Sift

In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held onyour CV.

At full sift your CV and your Personal Statement, will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.

We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.

Interview

During the panel interview, you will be asked Behaviour-based questions and Strength-based questions to explore what you enjoy and your motivations relevant to the role.

[
This is an example of a strengths-based question]
:

"It is often said that the customer's needs should come first. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?"

There is no expectation or requirement for you to prepare for the strengths-based questions in advance of the interview, though you may find it helpful to spend some time reflecting on what you enjoy doing and what you do well.

Interviews will take place face to face at Bristol - Regional Centre. Sift and interview dates to be confirmed. Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.

Eligibility

Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form . Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk - Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example - 'Please re-open my application - [insert vacancy ref]
& vacancy closing date [insert date]'.

To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application .

The HMRC app can help you with your application

The HMRC app can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.

If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.

Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.

How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account

Download the free HMRC app from the App Store or Google Play store.

If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.

You'll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.

You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services .

Reserve List

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles - if this applies to you, we'll let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.

Merit List

After interview, a single merit list will be created, and appointments will be made in strict merit order until the set demand is filled. If successful, you will be informed when we reach your position on the merit list.

Criminal Record Check

Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex-offenders Policy.

Hybrid working at HMRC

HMRC is an office-based organisation, and colleagues are expected to spend 60% of their working time in the office. Our offices provide opportunity for interaction, collaboration which aids learning and development and a sense of community. Where the role allows it, and where the home environment is suitable, colleagues can work from home for up to 2 days a week, averaged over a calendar month (or a proportionate amount of time for colleagues who work less than full time).

Reasonable Adjustments

We want to make sure no one is put at a disadvantage during our recruitment process. To assist you with this, we will reduce or remove any barriers where possible and provide additional support where appropriate.

If you need a change to be made so that you can make your application, you should:

Contact the UBS Recruitment team via unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk as soon as possible before the closing date to discuss your needs.

Complete the "Assistance required" section in the "Additional requirements" page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if you're deaf, a Language Service Professional.

Technical Support

If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our ' help ' section, then technical support is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.

Additional Security Information

Please note: in addition to the standard pre-employment checks for appointment into the Civil Service, all candidates must also obtain National Security Vetting at Security Check (SC) clearance level for this vacancy. You will normally need to meet the minimum UK residency period as determined by the level of vetting being undertaken, which for SC is 5 years UK residency prior to your vetting application. About The Company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About The Team/role

We are looking for a customer-centric operations analyst to join us on the 99Food team. Our mission is to build the best experience for our users and to drive strategic and sustainable growth.

In this role, you will work on cross-functional strategic projects, and will be responsible for supporting data analyses that will help shape our business strategy. This includes creating business hypotheses, testing them, and developing solutions to improve our growth. Hence, you will be able to improve both your technical and business skills through industry experience that will contribute to your professional development.

In this role, you'll be...

Creating SQL queries to help analyze business metrics;
Doing A/B Tests regarding Marketplace metrics and assisting the teams in decision-making;
Acting as a focal point for projects related to improving our Product solutions;
Aligning all points related to these projects with other areas (Marketing, Legal, Operations, Product, Research, Safety, and others);
Organizing all project information and transparently communicating developments and results to other teams in the company

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

SQL skills;
Analytical skills;
Academic background in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related areas (preferred);
Advanced English

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

jobs.title: Claims Operations Analyst (Kuala Lumpur)
jobs.location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
Claims Operations Analyst

Hybrid, Kuala Lumpur

In this role, you will focus on working closely with regional and country teams to deliver top-tier claims services across Asia, concentrating on efficient resource allocation and operational effectiveness. You will be supporting senior leadership with accurate, timely reporting and data to guide strategic decisions, while spearheading transformational projects to drive ongoing improvements and support business expansion. The team ensures the development of robust processes, communication plans, and training materials to facilitate quick implementastotion of changes within tight timelines. By collaborating with departments such as finance, underwriting, and regional claims leaders, you will aim to optimize portfolios, strengthen operational standards, and foster claims management excellence through active stakeholder engagement.

This is a regulated role under the Central Bank of Ireland’s Fitness and Probity regime.

What You’ll Be DOING

What will your essential responsibilities include?

Collaborating with Country Claims Management teams to drive superior claims service delivery, ensuring effective resource utilization aligned with the claims portfolio for the Asia region.
Supporting regional key leaders to develop and maintain timely, high-quality reporting and data to underpin strategic decision-making.
Leading transformational initiatives and other projects to support business growth through planning, development, and continuous improvement across the organization.
Ensuring operational efficiency by evaluating and improving operational processes, including risk identification, strengths, weaknesses, and quality assurance.
Developing and maintaining robust business readiness, communication strategies, training materials, and procedural guidelines.
Delivering rapid cycle changes and improvements within strict timeframes for the Asia region.
Providing regular updates on claims portfolio metrics, KPIs, and management information.
Servicing the claims team with operational and data requirements to ensure seamless claims handling.
Ensuring claims handlers are updated in operational guidelines and claims handling principles.
Managing audits, audit data requests, and related claims information.
Producing claims portfolio reports, including loss trends, financial movements, NatCat data, and other relevant metrics.
Collaborating with other functions such as finance, middle office, and underwriting to support wider business needs related to claims.
Partnering with the Head of Claims Singapore and Hong Kong to monitor internal claims projects, including portfolio optimization, vendor management, and audit frameworks.
Contributing to market engagement activities, including presentations and seminars, to promote claims management excellence.

You will report to the Claims Operations Lead, Singapore.

What You Will BRING

We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:

Qualification: Diploma and/or relevant insurance qualifications preferred
Equipped with related claims recoveries experience will be desirable
Sound knowledge of key product line(s) and regulatory environment
Up to date appreciation of the technical requirements of the role
Proven ability in identifying and analysing problems, creating good solutions, deploying sound decision making skills
Proven track record of knowing what it takes to provide a consistently first class customer service internally and/or externally
Ability to build effective working relationships internally and externally
Report writing skills, ability to develop and present ideas and reasoned arguments clearly and concisely to various audiences
Communication skills and ezcearticulate presenter to internal/external audiences, exercising appropriate discretion in dealing with people from all levels of the Company
Excellent attention to detail and a meticulous eye for identifying inconsistencies or inaccuracies in data entry or data outputs
Able to organise self (and others if applicable) including effective scheduling, prioritisation and time management skills, completing tasks to tight deadlines. Demonstrates a ‘can do’ attitude.
Comfortable taking ownership for own work, identifying the need for action (using initiative) whilst working effectively within a team.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office programs; specifically, Excel (including ability to manage if not write macros), Outlook, Word, Powerpoint

Desirable Knowledge and Skills

Experience in a Financial Services environment
Demonstrable evidence of interpreting and manipulating data clearly and accurately with the ability to articulate key points
Displays a resilient and adaptable style, track record of remaining calm in demanding circumstances, adjusting comfortably to changing conditions / priorities
The role would suit a highly driven self-starters, with a desire to challenge and deliver.

Who WE Are

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.

How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.

With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.

Learn more at axaxl.com

What We OFFER

Inclusion

AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.

Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Total Rewards

AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.

We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.

Sustainability

At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

Our Pillars

Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

jobs.description:
Position Title Clinical Operations Analyst Bariatric Services

Location Marina del Rey California

We are currently representing a leading healthcare organization in the Marina del Rey area seeking a dedicated Operations Analyst to support their specialized Bariatric Clinic. This is a full time role designed for a professional who is passionate about leveraging data to improve patient outcomes and clinical efficiency within a world class hospital setting.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the comprehensive review of surgical charts to identify complications, readmissions, and extended hospital stays. You will serve as the primary point of contact for the Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery Accreditation and Quality Improvement Program registry, ensuring all clinical data is submitted accurately and within required timeframes.

Key responsibilities include conducting deep dive research into program efficiency and patient safety. You will develop sophisticated dashboards and metrics to translate complex data sets into actionable insights for executive leadership. The role involves leading quality assurance projects, facilitating process improvement discussions with surgeon offices, and preparing the department for rigorous accreditation audits.

Candidates should possess strong analytical skills to manage large data sets from multiple sources while maintaining total data integrity. You will work closely with the Program Director to build strategic reports that guide the clinic's long term decision making and operational excellence.

Requirements

Bachelor degree in Health Administration, Business, Nursing, or a related field is preferred.

International Medical Graduates are highly encouraged to apply.

Minimum of two years of experience in operational or quantitative analysis.

Previous experience in an acute care or healthcare setting is strongly preferred.

Current Basic Life Support certification is required.

California Registered Nurse license is a plus but not required.

Advanced proficiency in data analysis software and project management methodologies.

Ability to identify minor flaws or trends in data that others might overlook.

Strong communication skills for presenting findings to high level stakeholders.

Our client offers a collaborative environment where every team member contributes to a culture of compassion and integrity. This is an excellent opportunity for an analyst who wants to see the direct impact of their work on community health and safety.

jobs.description:
Azenta Inc.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity

Job Title

Sales Operations Analyst

Job Description

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

Azenta Life Sciences is a global leader in the life sciences space with headquarters in Burlington, MA, and offices and operations worldwide. We are a market leader in automated bio sample management solutions and genomic services across areas such as drug development, clinical and advanced cell therapies for the industry's top pharmaceutical, biotech, academic and healthcare institutions globally. We provide unparalleled capabilities with our lab analysis, sample management and storage services, informatics software, and consumables, with the largest installed base managing millions of samples globally.

How You’ll Add Value:

As a key member of our Sales Operations Team, you will work closely with the Business Strategy Director, Regional Sales Directors, Sales Representatives, and other key stakeholders to assist in all support areas of sales. You will be responsible for managing processes, Azenta Business Systems, and data to drive revenue growth. This role will require being able to handle tasks from reporting and analyzing data to process improvement and ensuring sales strategy aligns with business goals.

What You’ll Do:

The Sales Operations Analyst will support our SMS Channel and C&I Sales team in driving operational excellence and assist with day-to-day administration and operational tasks such as:

Support the Business Strategy Director and Regional Sales Directors to achieve company and team goals.
Create dashboards to maximize our data for key insights and decision-making
Aide in monthly, quarterly and yearly planning, business direction, and business development efforts.
Support Sales Managers and Sales Leadership to achieve company and team goals
Improve processes and platforms to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer experience.

Key Responsibilities include:

Strategize with Business Strategy and Sales managers on implementing key performance indicators and communicate regularly on performance metrics.
Recommend strategic priorities, Salesforce performance metrics and sales effectiveness tracking methods to maintain and improve Azenta’s competitive advantage in the market.
Identify and implement process improvements in the SMS Channel/C&I organization that enhances sales productivity and simplify the sales process.
Partner with key stakeholders to identify, plan and deliver future enhancements with clear prioritization, effective resource planning, and strong project management.
Work with the sales and marketing leadership team on strategies for the sales organization.

What you will Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.
3+ years of experience in Sales Operations role with sales force effectiveness required.
Proven experience with creating complex dashboards in Excel or similar programs that allow multiple dataset inputs.
Proven experience with manipulating data in Excel, analyzing data sets, creating pivot tables, and using formulas.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
Proven experience with Salesforce and Oracle Cloud.
Proven experience developing efficient and effective operational processes and technology solutions.
Proven experience developing efficient and effective dashboards for data visualization, operational processes and technology solutions.
Ability to understand strategic direction, goals, and support processes to facilitate achievement of business objectives.
Result-oriented and success-driven mindset, conveying a sense of urgency and driving issues to closure.
Ability to build relationships with leaders, employees, and customers.
Solid oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly to other stakeholders in different functions at various levels.
Highly motivated, goal-orientated and outgoing. Self-starter – able to plan own schedule and priorities. Demonstrated initiative and self-development.

Working Conditions/Schedule:

Location: Onsite in Burlington, MA 4+ days/week
Travel Expectations: <10% of time spent traveling

EOE M/F/Disabled/VET

If any applicant is unable to complete an application or respond to a job opening because of a disability, please email at Recruiting@azenta.com for assistance.

Azenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, age, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a skilled Logistics Operations Center Analyst to support Army logistics current operations through operational planning, synchronization, situational awareness, executive decision support, and enterprise coordination. Successfully demonstrate competency in project execution, client delivery, critical thinking, and relationship management while upholding the highest standard of ethical behavior.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively.

This position is part of the team supporting the Army HQDA G-4 ELISS program, delivering innovative solutions that enable critical Army logistics and sustainment missions.

This position is full-time onsite in Arlington, VA**

Occasional weekend work may be required based on mission and operational needs.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Support Army logistics in the Logistics Operations Center to conduct analysis on current operations through operational planning, synchronization, monitoring, and execution of enterprise activities.
Conduct planning, research and analysis to evaluate continuity of operations (COOP), emerging issues, operational trends, and mission impacts and impact to Army sustainment equities.
Collect, consolidate, and analyze information from multiple sources to support situational awareness and executive decision making.
Develop executive-ready briefings, reports, decision papers, presentations, and operational updates supporting Army logistics leadership.
Coordinate operational activities, taskings, and recommendations across multiple Army organizations and stakeholders.
Monitor operational activities, milestones, deliverables, and action items while identifying risks, dependencies, and recommending mitigation strategies.
Support operational planning, issue resolution, and synchronization of Army logistics priorities across the enterprise.
Facilitate operational meetings, working groups, and collaborative planning sessions while documenting decisions and tracking follow-up actions.
Synthesize complex operational information into actionable recommendations that improve mission execution and organizational effectiveness.
Develop performance metrics, dashboards, and analytical products to enhance operational visibility and leadership decision making.
Support continuity of operations planning, operational reporting, and execution of enterprise initiatives, as required.
Support business development activities, including market research, proposal support, solution development, and client engagement, as required.
Perform additional consulting, analytical, and project support activities as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Public Administration, Management, Logistics, Operations Research, Political Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
3-10, or more, years of professional experience supporting Army logistics, current operations, within DoW, or other complex Government organizations.
Experience conducting operational analysis, current operations planning, or organizational assessments.
Strong analytical skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience using spreadsheets, databases, and collaboration tools.
Demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources into concise, actionable recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing executive-level briefings, reports, and presentations.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and work effectively within cross-functional teams.
Self-directed, detail oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in dynamic environments.
Available for occasional travel.
This position requires an active Top Secret security clearance. Applicants must be U.S. citizens

Desired Skills

Advanced degree in Business, Public Administration, Management, Logistics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience in COOP operations or as a SME in a DoW operations center
Three to 10, or more, years of experience supporting Army logistics current operations with a global operations impact.
Experience supporting headquarters level operations, operational planning, task management, or enterprise coordination.
Experience developing operational dashboards, performance metrics, executive reporting, or data visualization products.
Familiarity with business process improvement, workflow modernization, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.
Experience facilitating cross-functional operational working groups and stakeholder engagements.
Excellent research, writing, briefing, and staff coordination skills.

Target salary range: $100,000-$135,000

jobs.title: Merchant Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Acerca de PayJoy

PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.

Acerca del rol

Como Merchant Operations Analyst, trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con comerciantes de todo el país. En PayJoy, tu rol implica interacciones estratégicas, transacciones impulsadas por análisis y gestión de proyectos cruciales para fomentar asociaciones exitosas y estimular el crecimiento empresarial. Serás el principal enlace entre nuestra empresa y nuestros valiosos socios comerciales, desempeñando un papel fundamental en el fortalecimiento de relaciones sólidas.

Un candidato exitoso se destacará por su habilidad para comunicar sus ideas de manera asertiva, resolver problemas de manera efectiva y mantener un enfoque constante en la mejora continua. Deberá poder articular claramente sus pensamientos, liderar equipos pequeños, influir positivamente en su entorno con soluciones innovadoras y demostrar un fuerte compromiso con el crecimiento personal y profesional

Responsabilidades:

Apoyo a los comerciantes en todos los aspectos de sus operaciones administrativas.

Realizar conciliaciones para los pagos a los socios, gestionar promociones y asegurar pagos oportunos a los socios. 

Garantizar el pago puntual de comisiones, promociones, incentivos, etc. 

Apoyo en el proceso de planificación empresarial incluyendo descubrimiento, ideación, dimensionamiento de iniciativas, creación de planes de negocio, configuración de gobernanza e inicio de ejecución. 

Colabora con otros equipos de PayJoy para asegurar la exitosa ejecución de proyectos regionales. 

Simplificar y sintetizar estructuras complejas para comunicar efectivamente el valor.

Viajar según sea necesario para apoyar el crecimiento de las cuentas de PayJoy.

Cultivar relaciones sólidas con nuestras oficinas globales. 

Liderar proyectos de mejora que requieren interacción con diversas áreas como desarrollo de productos, ventas, etc.

Requerimientos:

Más de 3 años de experiencia en soporte y/o gestión de cuentas en sectores como telecomunicaciones, retail y finanzas. 

Experiencia comprobada en la gestión de KPIs. 

Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de comunicación (tanto verbal como escrita). 

Dominio avanzado del inglés para comunicación verbal y escrita. 

Conocimientos avanzados de Google Suite u Office, con especialización en Excel.

Licenciatura en ingeniería industrial, administración o un campo relacionado.

Beneficios:

Seguro de salud para el empleado y familiares directos

Financiamiento para teléfono, audífonos, equipo para oficina en casa y beneficios de bienestar

30 días de vacaciones

$2,000 USD beneficio anual para Co-working travel

$2,000 USD beneficio anual para desarrollo profesional. 

Principios de PayJoy

En PayJoy estamos orgullosos de ser un empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades. Damos la bienvenida y alentamos la inclusión de personas de todos los orígenes. No discriminamos por raza, religión, color, origen nacional, género (incluido el embarazo, parto o condiciones médicas relacionadas), orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género, edad, estatus como veterano protegido, condición de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica legalmente protegida.
