new_jobs.title: Regional Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
About The Job

Job summary

Explore the world of HMRC Estates, where we lead the way in government property transformation. As a key player in one of the UK's largest property programmes, HMRC Estates offers safe, inclusive workplaces and exceptional career development opportunities. Our team is dedicated to delivering high-quality, user-friendly services that enable our colleagues to thrive in an environment where they truly belong. Watch the video below to meet some of our team and come and discover a career in your hands at HMRC.

Build a Career in Property with HMRC Estates

Estates is at the forefront of delivering the biggest property programme in the UK. We are the leading edge of Government property transformation. The purpose of Estates is to provide HMRC with an estate which is the right size and shape to meet both the current and future needs of our customers in HMRCs business areas. We are a customer service organisation which exists to offer high quality, easy to use services to enable our colleagues to perform at their best by providing working environments in which they want to work.

Job Description

In this role, you will be responsible for assuring the efficient and effective management of all aspects of operational security for sites within your area of responsibility.

You will contribute to managing the contract by being responsible for monitoring and reporting Key Performance Indicators associated with HRMC's external security service providers .

You will ensure that day-to-day responsibilities for building related operational security obligations are met in accordance with the National Security Policies, including those policies that are owned by other directorates and government departments.

You will operate in line with HMRC's strategy, Government standards and industry best practice to promote and enhance site security and preparedness to keep HMRC's people, assets, and buildings safe and secure.

Person specification

Key Responsibilities

Identify, record, and analyse all building related security risks.
Undertake Level One Security Assurance in line with documented processes.
Work with the stakeholders to support and progress Security initiatives and project work.
Produce and maintain building security management documentation.
Undertake regular security reviews to ensure controls are adequate and meet existing standards and emerging threats and risks.
Work closely with the supplier with day to day activities and performance assurance.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of physical security posture.
Support and collaborate with the incident manager with operational security incidents in line with HMRC and cross government guidelines.
Actively engage in any security exercises and initiatives Communicate security status, updates, risk and issues.
Proactively seek out and develop and expand contacts and networks and share best practice from lessons learnt and networking in order to drive continuous improvement.
Be visible and provide Security SME (Subject Matter Expert) advice.
Management security systems access and disclosure of information in line with guidance.
On-call requirement for out of hours cover.

Essential Criteria

Experience and knowledge of an operational security environment.
Experience of contract management skills.
Experience of customer relationship management including dealing with a diverse range of stakeholders.
Proven track record of analysing and resolving problems, developing opportunities, and implementing innovate solutions/approaches.
Able to demonstrate personal self-development.
Knowledge of operational security risk management.

Further Information

If one of the following is not already held, there is an expectation to complete the following:

BTEC level 5 in Security Management within 2 years.
Contract Management Foundation Level within 6 months.
Threat and Risk Analysis Training Pathway incorporating BTEC Level 4 in Security Coordination and Design within 2 years.
Membership of the security institute.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

Making Effective Decisions
Working Together
Managing a Quality Service
Delivering at Pace

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £37,682, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £10,916 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.

Pension - We make contributions to our colleagues' Alpha pension equal to at least 28.97% of their salary.
Family friendly policies.
Personal support.
Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what it's really like to work for HMRC hear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths and Experience.

How To Apply

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

A name-blind CV, to include your Job History, Full Qualification Details and Previous Skills/Experience.
A 750-word Personal Statement, describing how your Skills and Experience would make you suitable for the role, and how you meet the Essential Criteria and Person Specification.

Sift

In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held onyour CV.

At full sift your CV and your Personal Statement, will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.

We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.

Interview

During the panel interview, you will be asked Behaviour-based questions and Strength-based questions to explore what you enjoy and your motivations relevant to the role.

[
This is an example of a strengths-based question]
:

"It is often said that the customer's needs should come first. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?"

There is no expectation or requirement for you to prepare for the strengths-based questions in advance of the interview, though you may find it helpful to spend some time reflecting on what you enjoy doing and what you do well.

Interviews will take place face to face at Bristol - Regional Centre. Sift and interview dates to be confirmed. Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.

Eligibility

Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form . Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk - Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example - 'Please re-open my application - [insert vacancy ref]
& vacancy closing date [insert date]'.

To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application .

The HMRC app can help you with your application

The HMRC app can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.

If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.

Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.

How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account

Download the free HMRC app from the App Store or Google Play store.

If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.

You'll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.

You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services .

Reserve List

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles - if this applies to you, we'll let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.

Merit List

After interview, a single merit list will be created, and appointments will be made in strict merit order until the set demand is filled. If successful, you will be informed when we reach your position on the merit list.

Criminal Record Check

Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex-offenders Policy.

Hybrid working at HMRC

HMRC is an office-based organisation, and colleagues are expected to spend 60% of their working time in the office. Our offices provide opportunity for interaction, collaboration which aids learning and development and a sense of community. Where the role allows it, and where the home environment is suitable, colleagues can work from home for up to 2 days a week, averaged over a calendar month (or a proportionate amount of time for colleagues who work less than full time).

Reasonable Adjustments

We want to make sure no one is put at a disadvantage during our recruitment process. To assist you with this, we will reduce or remove any barriers where possible and provide additional support where appropriate.

If you need a change to be made so that you can make your application, you should:

Contact the UBS Recruitment team via unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk as soon as possible before the closing date to discuss your needs.

Complete the "Assistance required" section in the "Additional requirements" page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if you're deaf, a Language Service Professional.

Technical Support

If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our ' help ' section, then technical support is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.

Additional Security Information

Please note: in addition to the standard pre-employment checks for appointment into the Civil Service, all candidates must also obtain National Security Vetting at Security Check (SC) clearance level for this vacancy. You will normally need to meet the minimum UK residency period as determined by the level of vetting being undertaken, which for SC is 5 years UK residency prior to your vetting application. What You’ll Be DOING

What will your essential responsibilities include?

Collaborating with Country Claims Management teams to drive superior claims service delivery, ensuring effective resource utilization aligned with the claims portfolio for the Asia region.

Inclusion

At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. new_jobs.description:
Referment is working with a London-based financial technology company that supplies specialist credit data and analytics to some of the world's largest investment banks, asset managers and hedge funds. Its platform automatically structures bond and loan data across thousands of issuers in the US, Europe and emerging markets, giving credit teams auditable fundamentals on demand.

They are growing the market data team that owns the integrity of the bond and loan pricing and reference data behind their global credit product. As their new market data analyst, you will sit between the product and engineering teams, making sure the pricing data clients receive is right and building the automated checks that keep it right.

The Role

Review pricing feeds from a third-party pricing provider against internal benchmarks, investigating anomalies rather than accepting them.
Sift through large bond and loan price and reference datasets to identify, prioritise and resolve outliers, including tracing capital structures and inter-company relationships to keep aggregate-level data sound.
Calculate and validate bond and loan pricing data at scale, from YTM, YTW and z-spread to Macaulay and modified duration and PV01.
Build automated algorithms that reduce manual reviews and checks, and document or escalate recurring data quality issues to the pricing vendor and internal stakeholders.
Answer client questions about data and product functionality, working directly with leading investment firms.

What We're Looking For

Experience in evaluated pricing, independent price verification (IPV), fixed income valuations or trade support, or credit fund NAV pricing, for example as an investment bank IPV or vendor-side pricing analyst.
Strong familiarity with bond and loan reference data syntax and pricing feed structures, and command of pricing conventions (clean versus dirty price, accrued interest, day count) so you can sanity-check a price against its fundamentals.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex spreadsheets with macros or Apps Script; Python, SQL or similar coding experience is a plus.
A demonstrated ability to work through large, messy datasets to find the one wrong number that everyone else's process missed.
A strong academic track record and sharp analytical and quantitative reasoning; an understanding of simple and complex corporate capital structures is useful.

This could suit an IPV, evaluated pricing or fixed income operations analyst at a large bank or data vendor who wants more ownership, a faster pace and the chance to automate the checks they currently run by hand. The role is permanent, full time and hybrid, based in London, with remote working flexibility offered by the company.

Description

AWS builds the custom silicon and platforms that power the world's largest AI and machine learning workloads. We are looking for an exceptional Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the most complex, cross-organizational programs behind AWS's AI accelerators — Trainium and Inferentia.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery of ambiguous, high-stakes programs that span silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks. You will bring structure to ambiguity, drive alignment across many teams, surface and resolve the critical path, and hold a diverse set of stakeholders accountable to commitments. You will be the connective tissue that turns a portfolio of independent efforts into a coherent, on-time delivery — and the trusted voice leadership relies on for a clear-eyed view of status, risk, and the decisions that matter. This is a rare opportunity to shape how purpose-built AI infrastructure gets built and shipped at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Own the planning and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-functional programs spanning silicon, hardware, software platforms, and ML frameworks — defining scope, milestones, dependencies, and the critical path.
Drive alignment across many teams and leaders; establish mechanisms (planning, status, risk reviews) that keep a complex program moving and transparent.
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks; drive mitigations and force clarity on trade-offs before they become launch-blocking.
Translate ambiguous, high-level goals into concrete plans with clear owners, dates, and success criteria.
Communicate crisp status, risks, and decision asks to senior leadership; be the single source of truth for program health.
Raise the bar on program management practices and mechanisms across the org, driving continuous improvement in how the team plans and executes.

A day in the life

You start the day scanning program dashboards and updating the critical path from a partner team. Use JIRA extensively
for task management, reporting and software-development metrics.
Work with Confluence
for documentation.
Participate in program meetings and provide status updates for the projects being executed by the assigned teams.
Maintain a high-fidelity understanding of the major technical projects being executed by each team.
Understand and operate within a structured Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
.
Coordinate effectively across engineering teams where initiatives have cross-team dependencies.

Engineering Environment
The individual will support three engineering teams:
Data Engineering Team

Largest team
Approximately 8 individual contributors + manager
Data engineering is a major component of the work.

AI / Machine Learning Team

Works on neural networks and related AI/ML initiatives.

Additional Engineering Team

Smaller team of approximately 3–4 people.

The candidate does not need to be an AI/ML or Data Engineering SME
, but exposure to these areas is a strong advantage.
Must-Have / High-Priority Experience
1. Strong hands-on Scrum experience – MUST HAVE

Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Agile Project Manager or similar.
Has personally led Scrum ceremonies
, rather than simply working in a Scrum environment.
Experience supporting multiple engineering/software development teams
.
Comfortable working with two-week sprint cadences.
Experience facilitating ceremonies and helping teams maintain delivery discipline.

2. Strong JIRA proficiency – VERY IMPORTANT

Gerald specifically emphasized a high level of JIRA proficiency.
Candidate should be extremely comfortable using JIRA as a software-development task management and reporting platform.
Experience with JIRA reporting, dashboards, sprint tracking, metrics and team health/performance is highly valuable.

3. Technical/Software Development Environment

Good understanding of SDLC.
Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
Ability to understand technical projects at the team level without necessarily being the technical SME.
Experience with engineering project status, dependencies and delivery tracking.

4. Technical Project Management

Must understand project timelines and status for their assigned engineering teams.
Should be able to communicate project status in program meetings.
The candidate will own the timeline/status for their team's component
, not the entire cross-team program.

Strong Nice-to-Haves
Data Engineering

Previous experience working with data engineering teams or data engineering projects is highly desirable.

AI / ML

Exposure to AI, machine learning, neural networks or LLM-related engineering projects is a strong advantage.

Atlassian

JIRA is highly important.
Confluence experience is preferred.
Broader Atlassian Suite experience is a plus.

AI Automation / Development

Interest or experience in using AI to build automations, skills or workflows is a plus.
Exposure to tools such as Cloud Code / CodePilot or similar AI-assisted development/automation environments is beneficial.
Experience building AI-powered automations is a differentiator, but not a core requirement
.

Ideal Experience Level
Gerald specifically indicated that the sweet spot is approximately 5–8 years of experience
because of the complexity of the environment.
3–5 years
could work for a more traditional software-development environment, but for this particular role Gerald feels 5–8 years is the ideal range
.
Candidates with 15+ years
are not automatically rejected, but they need to genuinely be comfortable with the scope and understand that this role has limited ownership compared with senior/principal-level Technical Program Management positions.
Important Red Flags
Avoid candidates who are:
Primarily Senior/Staff/Principal Technical Program Managers
accustomed to owning large programs end-to-end.
Used to having significant strategic/program-level ownership and decision-making authority.
Expecting to own an initiative from inception through final delivery.
Primarily Product Managers
rather than Scrum/Agile practitioners.
Primarily Agile Transformation Consultants or Enterprise Agile Coaches.
Highly focused on Agile transformation, organizational change or coaching rather than hands-on Scrum execution.
Candidates who may become frustrated by a structured, process-heavy pharmaceutical environment.
Candidates whose Scrum experience is only theoretical or certification-based without actually leading ceremonies.
Candidates with no meaningful JIRA experience.

Agile Coaching Clarification
Gerald specifically stated that deep Agile transformation/coaching experience is NOT required
.
The organization currently uses Scrum primarily as a framework and is still developing its broader Agile mindset. Therefore, a candidate who is heavily focused on Agile transformation may not be the best match.
The priority is:
Hands-on Scrum execution > Agile transformation/coaching

Technical PM vs. Scrum Master Split
Gerald estimated the role at approximately:
80% – Scrum Master / Agile responsibilities

20% – Technical Project Management

The Technical PM component is primarily focused on:
Understanding team-level project timelines
Tracking team deliverables
Understanding project status
Communicating status
Managing team-level dependencies
Understanding what each engineering team is executing

The candidate is NOT responsible for the overall program timeline
when multiple teams/repos are involved.

Top 3 – 5 Skills Needed for each role

Experience leading agile/scrum ceremonies for multiple teams
Proficiency to expert level experience in Atlassian tools for task management (Jira, Confluence)
Prior experience and familiarity working with data engineering and AI/ML engineering teams in software development/delivery.
Technical project management experience on mid to large scale software projects.

Agile Specialist

As the Agile Specialist, you will report to the Senior Manager, Agile Practices as well as continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve the most important technical problems.
You Will:

Lead and refine continuous planning, ensuring ongoing planning for and visibility to a rolling quarter + plan for the team/s you support.
Maintain engineering team schedules, ensuring proper resource planning and translation of estimates to key milestone dates.
Track project milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and timelines to ensure projects and programs stay on track and meet delivery timelines.
Remove obstacles that may hinder the team's progress.
Coordinate communication between different teams, departments, and stakeholders.
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and PMO to manage and prioritize the product backlog.

Serve as the key liaison between software development teams and external stakeholders building advocacy and credibility.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog maintenance and refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Promote Agile best practices and educate team members to enhance team performance and productivity.
Support the JIRA management for teams they support and other tools as appropriate.
Provide burndown charts, velocity tracking, and other agile performance metrics to inform and resolve issues with the team and manager(s).

5+ years’ experience in an Agile environment with experience using Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

Job Description

Who We Are

For more than a century, we have devoted our energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty.
Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

What You Will Do

Support the Omnichannel Customer Supply Chain (OCS) workstream for Project Nexus, with a primary focus on planning, facilitating, executing, and documenting a comprehensive Value Stream Mapping (VSM) exercise.
You will bring cross-functional partners together to create a fact-based view of current processes, identify waste and bottlenecks, and design a practical future state.
You will ensure that each stage of the VSM—from preparation and workshop facilitation through analysis, documentation, and action planning—is clear, structured, and grounded in validated data.
The role will connect functions across OCS, particularly the Order to Cash team, to align processes, information, systems, handoffs, and ownership.
You will translate VSM findings into a prioritized improvement roadmap that supports better flow, service, visibility, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

VSM Planning and Leadership:
Define the scope, objectives, participants, approach, and schedule for current- and future-state VSM activities. Prepare and facilitate workshops with cross-functional stakeholders.
Current-State Documentation:
Document end-to-end process steps and flows, including material, information, and decision paths; handoffs; systems; lead times; wait times; queues; process owners; and controls.
Data Collection and Validation:
Identify required data, coordinate its collection, and validate assumptions with process owners and subject-matter experts. Establish a performance baseline using measures such as cycle time, order-processing time, OTIF, inventory accuracy, exception rates, and customer impact.
Workshop Documentation:
Capture process maps, observations, pain points, assumptions, open questions, decisions, and supporting data in clear, reusable documentation. Maintain version control and confirm accuracy with stakeholders.
Waste and Constraint Analysis:
Identify delays, rework, duplication, process variation, capacity constraints, and non-value-added activities. Work with stakeholders to investigate root causes and distinguish verified findings from hypotheses.
Future-State Design:
Facilitate the development and documentation of a practical future-state process, including proposed process changes, roles, controls, technology needs, and enabling capabilities.
Improvement Roadmap:
Convert findings into prioritized initiatives based on expected value, feasibility, risk, dependencies, and effort. Define milestones, accountable owners, success measures, and next steps.
Project Governance:
Track plans, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and changes. Provide timely, concise updates to sponsors and stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Build shared understanding and consensus across OCS teams and, where applicable, external partners.
Change Enablement:
Support stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption planning for redesigned processes.
Benefits Tracking:
Monitor implementation progress and work with relevant partners to validate benefits against agreed operational and financial targets.
Continuous Improvement:
Establish a repeatable approach for reviewing value-stream performance and identifying further improvements.

Required Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or equivalent.
Experience:
1+ years of project management experience, specifically within eCommerce or Retail environments (experience with Customer portals is a significant plus).
AI/Technical Proficiency:
Demonstrated experience in implementing software solutions, specifically Agentic AI or advanced automation.
Agile Methodology:
Familiarity with Agile Methodology and Scrum is required.
Analytical Rigor:
Strong problem-solving skills to devise solutions for complex deduction types and data validation hurdles.
Financial Acumen:
Ability to manage project deadlines while meeting strict budget and ROI targets (Projected ROI ≤1 year).
Communication:
Excellent skills to present complex AI solutions to both technical developers and non-technical executive staff across multiple geographies.
Leadership:
Proven ability to mentor project team members and build consensus across a global organization.

new_jobs.description:
What You Will Do

As GFT continues to grow and expand, we are seeking a Senior Traffic Engineer / Project Manager
to support our Transportation group in New York
. This role follows hybrid work model
, requiring regular attendance at our Woodbury, NY or New York, NY offices.

Working on the roadway / traffic team at GFT
offers the opportunity to engage in transformative projects that enhance transportation infrastructure and improve community connectivity. Whether working on highways and bridges or traffic engineering, our team excels in resilient, sustainable design and construction, delivering innovative solutions that address the complexities of modern, multimodal roadway systems and ensure safe, efficient, and reliable travel for all. Explore some of our signature roadway projects here.

What You’ll Be Challenged To Do

As a Senior Traffic Engineer / Project Manager, you will lead traffic engineering and design efforts on a variety of transportation projects throughout New York City and Long Island. You will play a key role in the planning, analysis, design, and delivery of traffic and transportation improvements while coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, agency stakeholders, and project managers.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical tasks, mentoring junior staff, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality engineering solutions that improve mobility, safety, and operational efficiency for clients including NYSDOT, NYCDOT, MTA, and local municipalities.

In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

Lead traffic engineering and traffic design tasks from project initiation through final design and construction support.
Perform and oversee operational analyses and simulations using Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, Highway Capacity Software (HCS), and other traffic analysis tools.
Prepare and review technical memoranda, traffic impact studies, operational analyses, traffic forecasting studies, and engineering recommendations.
Apply the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), NYSDOT and NYCDOT standards, and other applicable guidelines to leading with signing and striping design, signal warrant studies and maintenance and protection of traffic (MPT/MOT) plans.
Lead and review the development of traffic signal plans, including phasing, timing, detection, communications/interconnect systems, controller specifications, and signal warrant analyses.
Interface with clients, agency reviewers, and project stakeholders during project development, design reviews, and public outreach activities.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers.
Support project managers with scope development, scheduling, budget management, and proposal preparation.
Ensure designs comply with applicable federal, state, and local standards, policies, and engineering best practices.

Education | Experience:

What You'll Bring To Our Firm

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering.
Professional Engineer (PE) License in New York, or ability to obtain reciprocity within six months.
8–12 years of progressively responsible experience in
Traffic engineering, traffic signal design, and transportation design.

Demonstrated experience leading traffic design and traffic engineering tasks for NYSDOT, NYCDOT, MTA, or other public-sector transportation agencies.
Strong experience in traffic operations analysis, traffic impact studies, and traffic signal design.
Experience preparing contract plans, specifications, estimates, and supporting construction documentation.
Proficiency with MicroStation, ProjectWise, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, HCS, and related traffic analysis software.
Working knowledge of transportation design standards, MUTCD requirements, and agency design manuals.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively coordinate with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to independently manage technical assignments and oversee the work of junior staff.

What We Prefer You Bring

PTOE certification or ability to obtain in 1 year.
Familiarity with NYSDOT Highway Design Manual, Traffic Signal Design Manual, MUTCD, ADA/PROWAG requirements, and ITE methodologies.
ITS, traffic management systems, or transportation technology experience.
Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $165,000
; Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.

Featured Benefits

Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.
Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations.
Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more.

Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™

GFT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law.

We are seeking a skilled Project Manager to lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives within our client's broadband organization. This role will primarily focus on driving a critical outage management program aimed at improving how service disruptions are identified, managed, and communicated to customers across the enterprise footprint. The ideal candidate is a seasoned project/program management professional who excels at coordinating complex initiatives, aligning stakeholders, managing risks, and delivering business outcomes. While the role is heavily focused on project and program leadership (80-90%), the successful candidate must also possess enough business analysis and requirements experience (10-20%) to partner effectively with Business Analysts, validate requirements, identify process gaps, and contribute to business requirements documentation. This is a hybrid role that requires 4 days per week in the Stamford, CT or Denver, CO office. All qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship or visa transfers. Please note that we do not work C2C.

Key Responsibilities

Lead large-scale, cross-functional broadband programs from initiation through implementation.
Manage an outage management initiative focused on developing processes and systems that improve customer communication during service interruptions.
Build and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
Develop end-to-end business workflows and operational processes.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, proactively connecting related issues across workstreams and stakeholders.
Partner with Business Analysts to review requirements, identify process gaps, validate solutions, and contribute to Business Requirements Documents (BRDs).
Facilitate collaboration across business, technology, operations, product, and customer experience teams.
Establish and manage stakeholder communication plans, ensuring alignment at all organizational levels.
Drive program governance activities, status reporting, executive presentations, and decision-making forums.
Track project health, manage escalations, and ensure successful delivery of business objectives.
Influence stakeholders and navigate complex organizational dynamics to maintain momentum and achieve results.

Requirements

Minimum of 6 + years of project and/or program management experience leading complex enterprise initiatives.
Direct experience within the broadband, telecommunications, cable, or connectivity services industry.
Proven ability to manage large, cross-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies and program governance practices.
Experience developing project plans, managing timelines, tracking risks, and driving execution.
Ability to understand business requirements and collaborate effectively with Business Analysts and technical teams.
Experience creating or reviewing process flows, workflow documentation, and BRDs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify upstream/downstream impacts across a program.
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
Experience with outage management, service assurance, network operations, customer communications, or related broadband operational programs preferred.
Experience leading process improvement and operational transformation initiatives preferred.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, or related project management certifications preferred.
Experience working in highly matrixed enterprise environments preferred.

Compensation

Sand Cherry Associates is required by Colorado law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range considers a wide range of factors considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and delivery model. This is a long-term W-2, consulting engagement with an expected salary rate of $110,000-$120,000. Years of experience, level of education, geographic location, unique skills/qualifications for the specific role and potential certifications can be key factors in the final compensation for this role.

Benefits

Our team is unique — we are passionate about what we do. At Sand Cherry, our Consultants know they are impacting and shaping our clients’ industries. We recognize our employees for their contributions. Our culture is one of the most friendly and communicative in the consulting industry. Sand Cherry is not a top-heavy organization. We offer the opportunity to be part of a digital workforce. Discover the experience that only comes with self-responsibility in the workplace. Our team members manage their own workloads and are expected to deliver exceptional work for our clients. Professional career growth is one of our main priorities, as we affirm that investing in our Consultants and empowering our people will also deliver the best results and value for our clients.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Botrista, we are revolutionizing beverage culture with intuitive, Nature-guided drink-making technology. By empowering restaurants and establishments to expand their menus without added complexity, we are driving growth and innovation at the touch of a button. Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our solutions create a new industry category, applicable to any cuisine, demographic, and business. With rapid deployment of our machines nationwide, we are delivering extraordinary beverage experiences to customers everywhere.

Position Summary

Botrista is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Revenue Operations Analyst to help us better understand what drives revenue growth, customer performance, retention, and profitability across the business.

Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, this role will serve as a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance. The Revenue Analyst will connect data across Sales, Account Management, customer performance, deployments, operations, and financial results to identify trends, explain performance, uncover opportunities and risks, and support better business decisions.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable digging into complex data, and able to move beyond what happened to understand why it happened and what we should do about it.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with commercial judgment and can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Performance & Business Analysis

Analyze revenue performance against plan and identify the underlying drivers of variances.
Evaluate new customer revenue, recurring ingredient revenue, same-store performance, customer retention, expansion, cups sold daily (CSD), deployments, and other key revenue drivers.
Develop cohort and segmentation analyses across verticals, customer types, sales channels, territories, deal structures, acquisition sources, and other relevant dimensions.
Identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they become obvious in topline results.
Partner with Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance to develop a consistent view of commercial and financial performance.
Translate analysis into clear recommendations and business actions.

Sales Analytics

Analyze pipeline health, coverage, conversion, sales velocity, win/loss performance, quota attainment, and seller productivity.
Evaluate lead sources, territories, customer segments, ICP performance, and sales motions.
Support analysis of sales capacity, territory design, quotas, and resource allocation.
Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion.
Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time.

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base.
Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk.
Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance.
Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion.
Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring.
Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base.

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale → Deployment → Live → Productive → Recurring Revenue → Retention → Expansion

Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments.
Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis.
Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value.
Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created.

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting.
Build and maintain analytical models for revenue growth, customer performance, capacity, retention, and other business drivers.
Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis.
Evaluate the expected impact of changes in headcount, productivity, pricing, customer mix, retention, CSD, deployment timing, and other key assumptions.
Perform sensitivity analyses to help leadership understand the range of potential business outcomes.

Reporting & Business Reviews

Build and maintain core Sales, Account Management, and revenue performance reporting.
Support weekly and monthly business reviews with analysis of key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
Maintain consistent metric definitions and help establish a trusted source of truth across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.
Improve existing reporting by eliminating low-value metrics and introducing measures that better reflect business performance.
Automate recurring analysis and reporting wherever practical.

Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support leadership with analytical work on high-priority business questions, including:

Which customer segments and verticals generate the greatest long-term value?
What predicts high CSD, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion?
Where are we losing revenue and why?
Which sales motions and acquisition sources produce the highest-quality customers?
Where should we add or reduce Sales and Account Management resources?
Which programs and initiatives are generating measurable incremental value?
Where are operational bottlenecks limiting revenue?
Which parts of the business should we scale, improve, or reconsider?
What are we not currently measuring that could materially change how we operate?

Cross-Functional Operating Model

The Revenue Analyst will be a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.

The role reports to the Revenue Operations Manager, who will help prioritize the analyst's overall workload and ensure analytical work translates into commercial action. However, the analyst will work directly and regularly with Commercial Planning and Finance and will support important analytical and planning needs across all three functions.

Success requires operating as part of one analytical ecosystem rather than three separate teams. The expectation is to create shared definitions, shared data, and a common understanding of business performance while bringing the appropriate functional perspective to each analysis.

What Success Looks Like

A Successful Revenue Analyst Will

Surface insights leadership did not already know.
Explain the drivers behind business performance rather than simply reporting results.
Identify revenue opportunities and risks early enough for the organization to act.
Improve confidence in the metrics used to run the business.
Connect Sales and operational activity to actual customer and financial outcomes.
Reduce manual reporting and increase time spent on higher-value analysis.
Help Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance operate from a consistent view of the business.
Develop a deep enough understanding of Botrista's business model to independently identify questions worth investigating.
Consistently move from data → insight → recommendation.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Finance, Strategy, Business Operations, or a related analytical role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets.
Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
Experience with Salesforce data and CRM reporting strongly preferred.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools preferred.
Experience building financial, operational, forecasting, or scenario models.
Strong understanding of business metrics and ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the larger business question.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and business questions evolve quickly.

What We're Looking For

We Are Particularly Interested In Someone Who

Is intellectually curious and naturally asks "why?"
Enjoys finding patterns and anomalies in data.
Does not stop at producing a dashboard or spreadsheet.
Can distinguish correlation from meaningful business drivers.
Is comfortable challenging assumptions when the data suggests something different.
Can take an ambiguous business question and independently determine how to analyze it.
Understands that perfect data is rarely available and can make thoughtful recommendations while clearly communicating assumptions and limitations.
Wants their analysis to influence how a business actually operates.

Benefits

Fully company-paid Medical and 99% company-paid Dental and Vision Insurance
Flex PTO, 7 sick days, 14 holidays, Wellness Benefits, Cell Phone and Internet reimbursement, 401K

Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000

Job Description

Position Summary

R&D is establishing and scaling global development hubs in India and Poland as part of its Global Capability Model (GCM) transformation.
The program is building new R&D capabilities while simultaneously redesigning how work is organized, where capabilities are located, and how teams operate across the global R&D network.
The Functional GCM Project Management role will provide dedicated execution support to one or more R&D Functional Leaders. The role will help translate functional strategies and designs into executable workforce, change, onboarding, and transition plans and ensure that issues are identified and resolved before they disrupt implementation. The R&D GCM Lead will be the hiring manager for these positions and deploy the new team members to the R&D functions.
This is a hands-on role requiring strong project management, structured problem solving, and the ability to work across global functions, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, local site teams, and other GCM workstreams.
The role may be filled at different levels of seniority. Senior resources will lead the work with Functional GCM Leads and independently drive cross-functional execution. More junior resources will provide project management, analysis, and coordination support within the same areas of responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Functional GCM Execution

Partner with Functional GCM Leads to translate approved functional strategies and organization designs into practical execution plans.
Maintain an integrated view of functional milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, and issues across workforce build, change, onboarding, and transition activities.
Connect functional execution with the broader GCM program and identify dependencies requiring coordination across R&D functions, GCM sites, or enterprise teams.
Ensure emerging execution issues are surfaced early, with clear options and recommendations for resolution.

2. R&D HQ Transition Support and Hypercare

Establish and operate a high-touch transition support process for functions moving work, building new teams, or implementing new operating models.
Provide a clear point of coordination for transition issues raised by functional leaders, managers, and new teams.
Triage issues quickly, connect them to the appropriate owner, and drive follow-through until resolution.
Identify recurring issues and patterns that indicate broader gaps in processes, policies, onboarding, technology, or site readiness and escalate them through the GCM program.
The objective is not simply to track issues, but to remove friction and reduce execution risk during periods of significant organizational change.

3. Onboarding and Operational Readiness

Partner with Functional GCM Leads, hiring managers, and local India and Poland Knowledge Transfer PM teams to prepare for successful onboarding of new employees and teams.
Coordinate functional readiness for hiring cohorts, including manager preparation, local orientation, access and tools, role onboarding, and other dependencies required for employees to become productive.
Work closely with dedicated Knowledge Transfer PMs while maintaining clear separation between overall functional implementation and detailed knowledge-transfer execution.
Ensure dependencies between hiring, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness are visible and managed.

4. Workforce and Hiring Planning

Support Functional GCM Leads in finalizing workforce and hiring plans, including roles, locations, timing, sequencing, and hiring waves.
Maintain accurate functional demand and hiring plans and reconcile changes with Talent Acquisition, HR, and the central GCM workforce planning process.
Track progress from approved workforce demand through requisition launch, recruiting, and hiring, highlighting risks to planned timing or workforce assumptions.
Help identify practical adjustments to sequencing, role profiles, or hiring plans when market conditions or execution performance differ from assumptions.

5. Change and Communications

Support development and execution of divisional and functional change and communication plans associated with GCM implementation.
Work with Functional GCM Leads, HR, and Communications to identify affected stakeholder groups, key messages, leadership engagement needs, manager support, and employee readiness activities.
Coordinate functional change activities with the broader R&D GCM narrative and site-level communications.
Track change readiness, emerging concerns, and adoption risks and ensure they are addressed through the appropriate functional or program channels.

6. Business Cases and Functional Design Support

Support development of business cases for new or evolving functional GCM designs.
Coordinate collection and analysis of workforce, cost, timing, organizational, and operational assumptions required to assess proposed designs.
Work with Functional GCM Leads, Finance, HR, and the broader GCM team to prepare materials for design reviews and investment decisions.
Maintain traceability between approved business-case assumptions and subsequent execution plans.

Seniority Differentiation

Senior Project Management Resource (1 or 2 in total)

In collaboration with the R&D GCM Program Lead and GCM PMO Lead, senior resources will:
Serve as the primary execution partner to one or more Functional GCM Leads.
Independently lead integrated functional planning and execution.
Drive resolution of complex cross-functional dependencies and issues.
Challenge assumptions and identify gaps in functional implementation plans.
Lead development of business cases, executive materials, and decision recommendations.
Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions and drive decisions to closure.

Project Manager Resource (4–5 in total)

Ability to manage multiple interconnected workstreams with significant organizational and stakeholder dependencies.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate strategy or organization design into practical implementation plans.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of clear executive-level materials.

new_jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

In the role of Project Manager Engineering, we'll count on you to:

Direct and coordinate work of single or multidiscipline teams throughout the project's lifecycle (from development and initiation to close-out)
Responsible for all aspects of complex small to medium projects or routine large projects
Produce and coordinate several small to medium projects concurrently
Establish and maintain client relations, and be involved with marketing, contractual, design and production meetings
Conduct work sessions for deliverable development in conjunction with other staff and stakeholders
Coordinate staffing and workload through entire project life cycle, and ensure completion of deliverables on schedule
Track financial aspects of projects, and coordinate and adjust work effort with team to ensure that work is completed within parameters of agreed-to budget and schedule
Work with the Accounting, Operational and Business leadership for periodic project reviews
Implement QA/QC procedures
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree
PMP certification
Interest in advancing digital delivery and AI-supported workflows in infrastructure projects

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
7 years related experience inclusive of a minimum 2 years experience in project management
Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license.
MS Office and MS Project experience is required
Demonstrated leadership skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. The expected compensation range for this position depends upon skills, experience, education and geographical location. (Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions.
